name: Cast n Chill
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish
short: Cast n Chill is a relaxing fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.
about: Cast n Chill's a laid-back fishin’ game for folks who’d rather wet a line than break a sweat. Whether yer driftin’ on a lazy lake, pokin’ 'round a winding river, or droppin’ lines in salty blue water, this here’s a game where you set the pace.           Upgrade Yer Gear  Start with the basics, catch whatever bites, sell your haul, and put those coins toward better rods, reels, and upgrades. Before ya know it, you’ll be wranglin’  rare species  that’d make any angler green with envy.       Explore New Waters  Find yer favourite fishin’ hole or keep wanderin’. There’s  16 peaceful spots to discover , each with its own critters swimmin’ 'round, just waitin’ to bite.          Pick Your Pace  In   Active Mode  , you’re in the thick of it - castin’, reelin’, and keepin’ busy like a loon at nesting time.  Switch to   Passive Mode   if you’d rather let the game do the work while you’re off choppin’ wood.   Set it up on a  second monitor  or  tuck it in the corner  - come back later and see what kind o’ haul the fish gods left ya.          Collect 'Em All  There’s   50+ fish to discover  - some you’ll recognize, some you’ll squint at and go “what in the heck is  that ?” From scrappy little sunfish to big ol’ deepwater beasts, they’re all in the logbook waitin’ for your name.       Legendary Catches  There’s 16 fish out there that still get folks jabberin’ at ol' Rusty's bait shop like they saw Bigfoot ride a moose. Land one, and you'll be part o' the legend.          Boat Buddies  Grab your rod and call a buddy, Cast 'n Chill now has co-op! Whether you’re lookin’ to kick back and fish side-by-side or stir up a bit of friendly competition, it’s all better with company.       Trusty Companion  Nothin’ beats a day on the lake with a four-legged friend. They might not know a spinnerbait from a spoon, but they’ll help you spot a fish - if only 'cause they’re hopin’ for a bite themselves.       Restore Your Very Own Fishing Cabin  Roll up your sleeves and bring a worn down lakeside shack back to life, then kick back and enjoy the quiet while fishin’ off your own dock. Stock your pond, mount replicas of your best catches, and settle in while your trusty companion curls up by the fire.

name: Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French, German, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean, Spanish - Spain
short: Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! This is a relaxing and enjoyable idle fishing game that can sit at the bottom or any corner of your screen, allowing you to enjoy a leisurely sea fishing time in your busy life.
about: Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! A laid back fishing idler that lives on your desktop, along the bottom of your screen, or just about anywhere else you'd like. Take a moment to ease your mind as you take in the sea breeze, and wait for a bite! In Fish to Dish, you're a fisherman taking to the seas to reel in weird and wonderful creatures of the deep, and then serve them up as sushi. All kinds of customers await, their bellies rumbling... So upgrade your rod, unlock new bait, sail the seas, and even build your own aquarium tank!      • Start a relaxing fishing adventure from the bottom of your desktop screen. Watch as your boat sails the waves, reeling in new fish.   • Play at your own pace, and feel that sense of satisfaction as your boat heaves with awesome catches!Tap your keyboard or click your mouse to speed up the bite and reel in fish even faster!                 • Cast your rod in a range of bays and isles, each with their own unique sea life. You'll see everything from everyday fish, to rare leviathans of the depths.  • What's that floating over there...? Spot starfish, turtles, walruses, even rubber ducks and much more floating out on the waves!  • Fill out your bestiary as you haul in new species, and expand your sushi bar's menu.                         • Prepare your prize catches, and sell a delectable range of sushi dishes to earn gold.  • Level up your sushi bar and spruce it up with furniture and decorations. Make it your own to draw in all kinds of customers, and... cats?                 • Buy rod upgrades to fish more efficiently, and return to shore with a deck chock-full of fish!  • Pick out the right bait for the fish you're after, and reel in elusive rare varieties.                 • Float in relaxation, taking in the joy of fishing as the tides ebb and flow.  • Fill the hatchery with catches, and gaze over your rare fish as they flit within an aquarium ecosystem of your own creation.  • Bid stress farewell, and be at one with nature in Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi. Take time to fish at your leisure!                  Game FAQ   Q:   Screen flickering after Steam pop-up or pressing Shift+Tab?   A: Disable the Steam Overlay: Right-click Fish to Dish in your game library → Properties → General → Uncheck "Enable Steam Overlay while in-game." This only affects this game; others are unaffected.     Q: Game background is black?   A: Visit the store page → "Discussions" for a solution in the pinned post.     Q: Can DEMO save files be carried over to the full version?   A: No, carrying over saves may cause bugs.

name: Abracademia
lang: English
short: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.
about: Abracademia is  a cozy witch idle life-sim  that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play.                    Abracademia  runs quietly while you study , watch videos, or play other games.  Your wizard lives their life at your pace. You can micromanage every little detail or let magic handle the rest.    Move Abracademia around the screen, adjust the game speed, or pause anytime you want.                     Your journey begins after you receive your letter from Abracademia School.   Create your own wizard , shaping their appearance, their background, and even their magic wand.    Define a magical profile that reflects who you are,  shaping your strengths, your weaknesses,  and the kind of magic you naturally lean toward.    Finally comes the moment every mage waits for… the  test that determines your Coven.   Will you join the creative Waltzpurgis, the secretive Medusalem, or the outgoing Feynyx?  Each of the five  Covens offers its own unique content and spells.                      Abracademia takes place over five school years, leading up to your wizard’s graduation.  Your character will  attend classes every day, join activities , and, of course, take exams.  While some activities are mandatory, you decide how your wizard spends the rest of each day.    Do you want to be a studious scholar? A gossip queen? A pompous noble, quietly plotting in the shadows?  Or maybe someone who solemnly swears they’re up to no good.     In Abracademia, any path is possible.                     Classes, events, and quests earn you experience in magical disciplines, letting you unlock new spells.   With over 300 spells across 20 disciplines  (Home Magic, Transformative Arts, Umbra…), you can shape your wizard in your own way.  Use magic to get boosts, ace exams, make friends (or enemies), and experiment with different spell combinations to discover crazy synergies.    And if you like a little friendly competition, check the Students Leaderboard!                       Your wizard isn’t alone.  Other students can be rivals, allies… or perhaps something more.   You can study together, attend parties, compete in events, and build relationships that shape your school life.    As your friendships grow, you’ll unlock special quests, and if things go well, you might even end up with someone special in the epilogue!                 When classes are over,  you can dive into quests  and explore the Fabric of Worlds, a place where magical realities meet.  Choose to be a friendly neighborhood wizard, helping wherever you can, or dive into the intrigues of the Magical World and see where they take you!    Quests will reward you with unique items, but they will also test your spell mastery, your friends’ help, and careful stamina management.    Don’t worry, there’s always more than one way to solve a problem.

name: Magic Cursor
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Hungarian, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Czech, Japanese, Bulgarian, Vietnamese, Greek, Danish, Indonesian, Spanish - Latin America, Malay, Norwegian, Portuguese - Brazil, Romanian, Finnish, Swedish, Hindi
short: Transform your desktop with Magic Cursor. Choose from colorful cursor trails, screen effects, themed categories and mini-games to personalize every move of your mouse and make your desktop feel more dynamic, playful and magical.
about: Make the cursor part of your style   Magic Cursor  transforms your everyday desktop with visual effects that follow the movement of your mouse. Choose the effect you like, change the atmosphere of your screen, and discover mini-games designed around cursor control.  From natural phenomena and scientific experiments to magic, technology, and animals, Magic Cursor lets you find a style that matches your mood, game, or desktop.         Seven categories — countless different effects  The Magic Cursor collection is divided into seven themed categories:     Nature  — fire, water, snow, lightning, leaves, minerals, and other natural phenomena.     Mini-Games  — small games where mouse movement becomes your main tool: arcade challenges, reaction tests, dexterity, and precision.     Science  — atoms, molecules, chemical processes, physical phenomena, astronomy, and space-themed effects.     Technology  — digital effects, neon, holograms, electronics, engineering, aerospace technology, and futuristic visuals.     Magic  — runes, spells, potions, portals, fantasy glow, and other mystical effects.     Animals  — real, fantasy, and mythological creatures, tracks, insects, and other effects inspired by the animal world.     Screen Effects  — full-screen atmospheric scenes featuring weather, leaves, lighting, space, magical, and technological visuals.            More than cursor effects  Magic Cursor can change more than just the trail behind your mouse. Enable  screen effects  that work independently of the cursor and transform the atmosphere of your entire desktop.  Combine cursor and screen effects — for example, a magical effect with a night background, snow with a winter atmosphere, or a technological cursor with a futuristic environment.          Play with your cursor  Whenever you want a break, launch the built-in mini-games. Control a snake, catch fish, herd sheep, defend the planet, dodge obstacles, and take on other challenges using your mouse movement.

name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: Dive into a cozy, idle fishing experience! Cast your line from a little corner on your desktop. Customize your cute avatar and background, then feed and collect adorable cats of all breeds. Unlock beautiful scenes and jump into multiplayer and sneak in some "chill-time" with friends!
about: "Cozy~ Fishing Kitten" is a lighthearted desktop idle game where you can slack off with your friends, dress up your character with all kinds of outfits, collect different breeds of cats, and gradually unlock more slacking-off scenes.       Freely adjust the position and size of the game window and tuck it into a corner of your desktop. Cast your line and wait for a bite while you get things done. This whole pond is yours now!   When you have a moment, check out today's haul. From common little fish to creatures from the deepest seas, and even some downright strange fellows, every cast brings a surprise. Here, no angler ever goes home empty-handed!               Thanks to nature's gifts, collecting flotsam not only yields plenty of resources but also gives you a chance at mysterious eggs. And what hatches out of them? Cats that hatch eggs!   Stack cats on an egg to speed up hatching: the more cats, the faster it hatches. Dozens of furry friends are waiting to be collected, so go assemble your fluffy slacking-off squad!               Customize your avatar and hand-draw your own OC with the brush tool. Whether you're a trained artist or a stick-figure beginner, you can make your character look exactly the way you like. There are over 200 outfits and scene decorations to collect in the game, and gacha capsules give you a chance at ultra-rare looks.               Join multiplayer online rooms or invite friends to play together — fish and chat, share your catches, and trade your favorite outfits. Fun is better when shared: in this hidden little corner, a grand slacking-off party is quietly underway!               Cast your line and travel to the world's most beautiful sights right on your desktop, roaming between different fishing spots. A huge fish encyclopedia full of species and rarities awaits you to complete, and rare catches can even be displayed in your aquarium. Today, our goal: World Fishing Master!

name: Desk Top Racer
lang: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Danish, Spanish - Latin America, Finnish, Greek, Dutch, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Swedish, Thai, Czech, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Arabic
short: Turn your desktop into a living racetrack with this online idle racing management game. Build your garage, equip parts, and watch your cars run championships on their own. And whenever you like, take the wheel in Driving Mode against up to 20 players.
about: TURN YOUR DESKTOP INTO A LIVING RACETRACK   Desk Top Racer  is an online idle racing management game that lives on a strip of your desktop. Build your garage, prepare your cars, and let the races unfold while you work, study, or play something else. And whenever you like, take the wheel.  TWO WAYS TO PLAY   Automatic mode: you build, they race   The races run on their own. What matters is your strategy: pick the car, equip the parts, look after its condition, and go for the podium.     Tour:  32 countries to conquer, in championships of ten races.     Online races:  rooms of 20 drivers, matched with you by power level.     League:  MMR-based championships once you finish the Tour.     Weather:  six weather types in rotation change who has the edge each day.     Radar:  follow the race, the standings, and the records.     Driving Mode (experimental): now you drive   Accelerate, brake, and take the corners yourself. Cars are the same for everyone: it all comes down to your driving.     Multiplayer:  online rooms with up to 20 real drivers, with qualifying and a starting grid.     Practice:  race against bots on any track you like, with a braking guide line.    Your automatic race keeps running in the background, so you don't miss a thing.    A GARAGE THAT NEVER STOPS EVOLVING  Between one race and the next, there is always something to improve.   Parts, crates, and upgrades     Six part types in six rarities, from Common to Mythic.    Crates come from racing. Drag the part to its slot and watch your performance rise.    Upgrade your parts with no level cap, sell them for Credit, or dismantle them for Scrap.     Mastery, Collection, and Workshop      Mastery Tree:  invest in performance, economy, and automation, such as opening crates automatically.     Mechanical Collection:  complete part sets and earn stats for all your cars.     Workshop:  every car racks up mileage and earns paint points to unlock new colors.     Offline rewards:  keep earning Credit and Mastery even with the game closed.    ALWAYS SOMETHING TO DO     Weekly Missions:  five new missions every week, with DTR Coin as the reward.     Mascots:  ten companions with their own bonuses to win at the Mascot Machine.     TrackCards:  earn each country's card, evolve its rarity, and equip a set with bonuses.     Plincar:  short on Credit, Scrap, or Mastery? One DTR Coin buys a spin.    STEAM ITEMS: DISCOVER, COLLECT, AND TRADE  Some rewards may reveal  special items compatible with the Steam Inventory , identified in the game by the  M  badge. When eligible, they can be transferred between the game and your inventory.  Eligible items can be viewed or listed on the  Steam Community Market . Availability and prices are determined by the market and may vary.  FOLLOW THE RACE YOUR WAY  Keep the compact race strip on your desktop or open the panels to check your garage, your championship, the Radar, and your progression.  The track stays alive, and your next victory may be just one smart decision away.  THE FUTURE  Desk Top Racer keeps evolving. These are some of the features already planned:     Championship seasons:  season-based competition in automatic mode.     Driving Mode evolution:  its own ranking and attributes to assign based on your progress.     Team system:  join other players, earn rewards, and build your reputation.

name: Tiny Monster Haven
lang: English
short: A cozy idle creature collector that sits on your desktop as you go about your day. Grow crops, care for and level-up your companions and put them to the test in exciting monster battles!
about: A Relaxing Idle Creature Collector  Tiny Monster Haven sits cozily at the bottom of your screen, letting you raise your monsters at your own pace.     Become the caretaker of your own Monster Haven  and raise a variety of monsters to help run things smoothly.      Improve monster stats  by feeding them crops and delicious meals. Let them battle or play minigames to earn further rewards such as coins and Monster Essence, with which you can improve your Haven and monsters!     Each monster contributes in different ways : some will water and pollinate your crops while others help out with the harvest. Certain monsters even cook meals for your team!          Build up Your Monster Team     Choose your Starter  to take on your role as monster caretaker.            Plant many types of crops  and watch them grow while you play with your monsters or focus on other things. Once they're ready you can harvest and feed them to your monsters to improve their stats!     Cook delicious meals for your monsters  by choosing from a wide variety of tasty recipes! These delightful treats will further boost and level-up your monsters, making them more effective in combat and minigames.               Harness   Monster Essence  from defeated wild monsters. Use it to power-up and evolve your monsters or to expand your team with new monster eggs!           Embark on a Campaign to become the Best Monster Battler     Challenge the Elemental Gurus  and other tamers in an expansive mini-campaign.      Make the most of your monster team  in the challenging 2v2 and 3v3 battles.     Become the regional champion  by winning the grand tournament!            Put your monsters to the test  in tactical turn-based combat! Make clever use of varied stamina-based moves with tons of status effects. If your monsters are in a tough spot, perhaps their Overdrive ability can make the difference?            Hatch and evolve them all     Complete your monster compendium  by hatching and evolving over 50 unique monsters.     Make your compendium truely shine  with 2 Astral color variants per monster! Defeat a wild Astral  to pick up an Uncommon or Rare Astral Gem. Give it to an Egg and hatch your own Astral variants.    Chill and Customize your Haven     Decorate your Haven with tons of unlockable scenery . Scenery isn't just for show, every item you place will improve the efficiency of your monsters and your Haven.     Enter your monsters in various minigames  such as the Monster Race. Each minigame further enhances a specific skill.               Enjoy a Living, Breathing World      Experience a seemless day/night cycle and the passing of the 4 seasons . Each season has its own weather patterns such as rain or snow. Be on the lookout for certain wild monsters that only appear at specific seasons or at certain times of the day!

name: Casino Legends
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: Can you become the Legend of the Casino? Play across Texas Hold'em, Blackjack, Roulette, Slots, and Baccarat. Face 50 rivals who bluff, trap, and talk back. Buy once. Play offline. Verify outcomes. No chip packs or microtransactions.
about: FIVE CASINO CLASSICS. ONE COMPLETE GAME.  Build an offline casino career across Texas Hold'em Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Slots, and Baccarat. Poker is the main event, while four complete house games give you more ways to risk your bankroll and master the casino floor.  One purchase unlocks the complete game. There are no chip packs, energy timers, paid boosts, or real-money gambling.       POKER WITH A LIVING ROSTER  Face 50 distinct poker opponents, each with their own personality and playing style. Tight-aggressive sharks punish loose calls. Maniacs turn every pot into a confrontation. Calling stations refuse to fold.  They read the board, trap, semi-bluff, and run bluffs across multiple streets. Their ratings and current form shift as your career unfolds, while a flame indicator shows who is running hot or cold.  TALK TO THE TABLE  Use Table Talk and your opponents answer in character. The standard game includes authored character dialogue and works fully offline.  An optional download of approximately 2.5 GB adds locally generated AI dialogue. Once installed, the model runs entirely on your own PC without relying on a cloud service.  BUILD A CAREER THAT NEVER EXPIRES  Choose among unlocked rooms and climb through seven casino venues, from back-room tables to the high-stakes floor.  Earn EXP through the permanent Road to Legend, reach level 100, then continue through infinite prestige ranks. There are no seasons, expiring passes, or paid tier skips. The progress you earn remains yours.  OUTCOMES YOU CAN VERIFY  Deals, spins, and reel results use commit-reveal verification. The poker AI never receives your hole cards or the undealt deck, and the built-in verifier lets you check outcomes yourself.  The result follows the committed seed and the published game rules, not an adaptive house advantage.  BUY ONCE. PLAY FOR EVERYTHING.  No microtransactions. No chip store. No energy timers. No pay-to-win. No real-money gambling and no cash-out.  Earn chips through play and spend them on card backs, felts, chip sets, avatar frames, nameplates, and outfits. Titles and trophies are earned through your career. name: My Party Is Grinding
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Thai, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil
short: A desktop idle RPG where your party of five heroes fights, loots, and grows in a small window while you work.
about: Tuck a small transparent window into a corner of your screen — or anywhere you like — and let your party of five heroes keep fighting, looting, and leveling while you work, code, or browse.  My Party Is Grinding  blends the comfort of an idle game with the depth of a classic hack-and-slash RPG, right on your desktop. You're not grinding — your party is.           Lives on Your Desktop     A semi-transparent window runs right alongside everything else on your screen    Drag it anywhere, zoom in and out, pin it always-on-top, or click straight through it    Glance over between tasks, click a dropped chest, and collect your rewards     Five Heroes, One Party     Knight, Warrior, Assassin, Archer, and Mage — five classes, five distinct roles    Level up each class with stat points and a kit of active & passive skills — equip a loadout of up to four actives    Dress every class in unlockable costumes — wearing is purely cosmetic, so mix and match freely    Unlock new classes and expand your skill slots as you grow             Endless Loot, Deep Gear Crafting     Over 400 pieces of gear across 8 grades and 12 slots    Layered enhancement with gems, engravings, and enchantments    Forge, fuse, and craft at the Blacksmith; engrave, enchant, socket, and extract at the Mage Tower    Stockpile the random chests that drop in battle and open them whenever you like     Four Regions, 200 Battles     4 acts × 10 stages × 5 difficulties (Normal, Hard, Nightmare, Hell, Inferno)    Stage bosses and powerful act bosses that hit back with their own signature skills    Auto-challenge farms your current stage on repeat — and you keep earning gold & XP even while the game is closed (offline catch-up, up to 16 hours)             Progression That Never Stops     Orb Circuit — a sprawling directional growth tree with 200+ nodes    Constellations — a second growth axis with powerful keystone bonuses    Collections & Factions — completing costume gear collections grants permanent, party-wide bonuses, and owning more costumes from the same faction makes every hero stronger    Pets — unlock them by slaying monsters and keep their bonuses just by owning them     Automated Combat With Real Strategy     Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Chaos elements, each with their own status effects    A layered mitigation pipeline of dodge, block, damage reduction, and armor    Downed heroes and revives, plus a live damage meter to track each hero's contribution     League Battles and Rankings     Defeat other players' parties in duels for honor    Climb through eight leagues as your rating rises    Earn daily rewards based on your ranking             Trade Items on the Steam Community Market     Deposit gear of Epic grade or higher and materials of any grade into your Trade Vessel to register them in your Steam Inventory    List and trade them with other players on the Steam Community Market    Ownership of sold or purchased items is verified by the server and reflected in the game             Server-Based Online Game     All progress, items, and currencies are issued, stored, and verified on the server — your party is always safe    Rewards, crafting, and trades are all decided server-side — client tampering and item duping simply don't work    An internet connection is required to play    Grow a party that quietly, relentlessly gets stronger — right beside your taskbar.   Streaming, Gameplay Videos & Video Content   Streaming and video creation are allowed. Individuals and companies are free to stream, record, and publish footage of this game, including monetized content.  No prior permission needed: you don't have to contact us before publishing or streaming.  Including a link to the game's store page in your video description helps development a lot!

Artifacts  with automatic abilities — shockwaves, missile salvos, singularities, frost auras.     Emblems  with permanent stacking bonuses. Check in now and then to spend the coins you have earned on your characters and weapons.                Summon and merge characters to build your team. about: A  sim  and  idle medieval town management game  that thrives while you're doing your stuff. Craft hearty meals and bold brews to keep your patrons coming back  while your inn quietly grows into a full-blown medieval town.   Build, Brew & Belong.     Tidehaven: Ale & Trade  is a cozy yet authentic medieval inn  management & automation & design  game designed to fit your day. Just let your tavern hum along while you work or jump in to micromanage rush hours, strike shady deals, and expand a sleepy inn into a lively town, and if you want simply make it work at the bottom of your screen with the  compact mode .    From Inn to a Town    Start small and  grow room by room : kitchen, bedroom, market, stable,  a secret meeting room for under-the-table trades , and more. Grow your village beyond the inn, build  stable ,  butcher ,  blacksmith  and more to  shape your town .          Customize Everything           Unlock  tons of decor  and decorate your space in any style you like, you can even paint each tile on the floor! And some of these decoration items have a surprising bit of lore and  talent tree  too!              Talent Tree & Building with Perks   Every gem you pull from the earth is a decision waiting to be made. Invest in shadier income streams, a more efficient kitchen, or a bloodline of legendary horses. Your place, your call.           Cozy Medieval Vibe      Set between the 15th-17th centuries, Tidehaven pairs crackling hearths and clinking tankards with medieval tunes that makes time drift by. Strengthen your economy while expanding your tavern in most fashion way!   Is this game something for you?      Playing Full Screen or “bottom-of-screen” with the Compact Mode  for effortless second-screen play sound appealing?       Inn to town : Do you enjoy developing your place in your own style and discovering different mechanics and dynamics with each new building?      Try side events & mini-games, gamble  that spice up your routine with risks and rewards.              Pets?  Oh, we like pets. Name your  dog , breed  horses , and if you’re lucky keep a rare  parrot  in your room too.  Fishing ? Hmm… Soon.            And here is  no punishing gameplay  with constant difficulties that need perfect planning. Faster, chiller, relaxing, min-maxing,  every way is a right way here . No plague carts, no witch hunts, no non-stop raids! Put your fireplace, take a fresh ale, and do a little automation.

short: DEEPLANDERS is a minimalist construction puzzle game about populating the depths and bringing light into them. Build cozy underground cities and find the perfect place for each Deeplander to live in harmony.
about: DEEPLANDERS is a minimalist construction puzzle game about populating the depths.   A relaxed experience where you build cozy underground cities while finding the perfect place for each Deeplander to live in harmony.           Banished to live underground, these charming characters wander lost in the darkness. As you build, they begin to arrive, searching for a place to settle. Not everyone wants the same thing, and helping each Deeplander find their place becomes a gentle yet engaging logic challenge.           When a city is complete, the choice is yours. You can watch the Deeplanders live their lives while decorating the environment, or venture even deeper. Each descent writes a new chapter in their story, bringing new characters, environments, and ways to build.  Each depth can be solved in multiple ways, inviting you to replay and create different cities.           A mode that turns the Deeplanders into your desktop companions! Their underground world stays alive while you work, and you can interact with it by exploring the depths.           Please keep in mind that DEEPLANDERS is a small-scale game, made with great care and love. An experience that invites you to build, experiment, and shape small underground cities... because even the depths can be a beautiful place.     In DEEPLANDERS you can:     Build and decorate underground cities at your own pace.    Solve small organization puzzles.    Enjoy a relaxed and contemplative experience.    Replay a depth while looking for different solutions.     DEEPLANDERS does not include:     Mining or complex resource management.    Battles, fail states, or leaderboards.

name: Prigod Idle
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
short: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.
about: Prigod Idle is an idle auto-battler RPG. You choose a hero, equip their gear and abilities, then send them out to fight. They handle the combat, but the build is yours. Every piece of gear rolls its own random stats, so two players at the same stage can be getting completely different items. 100 stages, 38 heroes, 99 relics and four tech trees to spend them on.          If you are stopped by a boss, look at what it does and change your setup. Swap a weapon, socket different gems, try another pet or choose a different tech tree branch. Sometimes one good change is enough to turn a loss into a win.  New heroes and items are not only there to make your stats bigger. They give you more builds to try and more ways to handle your next adventure. BUILD YOUR HERO   38 heroes and every one of them plays differently   Gear with sockets, enchants and set-defining relic abilities   99 relics, 48 pets and 23 Fables to collect   Gems, enchants, pets and tech nodes all stack, so every build plays differently   Four tech trees and seven prestige branches to shape long-term power          WHEN YOU GET STUCK, CHANGE THE BUILD   A long campaign with special bosses that have their own mechanics. If you can't defeat an enemy, try something new!   8 dungeons, hard modes, Event enemies, a recurring World Boss and the PvP Colosseum, each with different fights to prepare for   A route map every run: pick your path, your fights and your rewards          EARN YOUR BUILD IN FIGHTS AND MINIGAMES   9 events, most with exclusive heroes and gear   22 minigames: dig for gems, brew potions, drop Plinko chips and many more   Build out your homestead, get pets and fill the Prigod Dex          YOUR DESKTOP COMPANION   Runs on the side while you do other things   Prestige unlocks new modules for automation   A compact portrait window that fits beside anything or extra panels for more info          NO INGAME STORE. OFFLINE PROGRESSION. PLAY IT FULLY IDLE IF YOU WANT   Full offline progress, including offline dungeon clears   Gems are earned by playing. No ads, no energy walls, no microtransactions   Unlock Auto-run and whole campaign runs play themselves. Wins move you forward. After a defeat, it farms the last stage you cleared.   Create separate character profiles when you want to try another pace mode or start over without deleting your current adventure.           Try the free demo! Your demo progress carries into the full game.  Wishlist it if you want to know when it launches. It helps me more than you would think. Thanks for reading this far :)

name: Kur - Endless Descent
lang: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, French, Spanish - Spain
short: An auto-battler RPG in the Mesopotamian underworld. Build a party of heroes, gear and level them up, set their formation, then watch them fight on their own through seven Domains and an endless descent. Free to play, in a small window that fits around your day.
about: Some depths should not exist. Yet we descend.  KUR is a free-to-play auto-battler RPG set in the underworld of Mesopotamian myth. Every fight plays out on its own: your power comes from how you build, equip and arrange your party. It runs in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work. Your party explores and fights on its own. You make the decisions that matter: who descends, what they carry, how they grow, and how deep to push.     Beneath the known world lies a realm of forgotten cities, sealed kings and fractured gods. What was buried still breathes.    Your screen, your way  KUR fits around your day. Resize the window, keep the full dungeon backdrop or switch to a minimalist view with just your party, or minimize it to a small indicator that keeps track of the descent while you work.    Key features    Auto-battler party combat: build, equip and arrange your heroes, then let them fight    Seven Domains, seven guardian Gates, and a descent with no bottom    80+ creatures drawn from Mesopotamian myth    Hundreds of named items across nine rarities, from Common to Absolute    Ash, limited Artifacts and player trading through the Steam Inventory    A passive skill tree for every class, and an account-wide Seal that never resets    Free to play, never pay to win      Build your party  Pick three heroes, never the same class twice. The Oathkeeper holds the line, the Ashblade brawls up close, the Hunter strikes from range and the Seer bends the fight with magic. Combine classes, skills and synergies to form the right team for the depth you are facing.    Seven Domains, one endless descent  Each Domain has its own laws, its own dead and its own guardian waiting at the Gate.     Ashen Vestibules : the only layer of KUR that still lets itself be read.     Ningiszida Rootways : not a forest. Growth without sun.     The Salt Cisterns : here death was not burned. It was kept.     The Lapis Vaults : KUR does not only kill. It records.     The Dust Courts : halls too large for the silence they hold.     The Seventh Threshold : here KUR stops pretending to be a place.     Kutha's Ember Works : inflicted death has a workshop, and it lies at the end.    Break the last Gate and KUR learns your name. The Mark claims you, and the descent begins again, deeper. New Domains open under the Mark, monsters return more corrupted, and every item that drops carries a numbered Sigil and stronger stats than anything found above. Each Descent also opens new engravings on your Seal. There is always another level down.    Ash and Artifacts  Ash is what KUR leaves behind, and every monster you fell can drop it. Ash gathered deeper is worth more. Gather enough and an Artifact emerges, numbered and permanent. Only a limited number of Artifacts can ever exist. Once found, an Artifact only returns to the world when someone uses it, so KUR feeds on itself: what one player spends, another can find. Artifacts are the rarest material in KUR and the key to its rarest gear, and we will never sell them.    Trading between players  Player trading is coming to KUR. Through the Steam Inventory, players will be able to trade equipment with each other, Artifacts included. Owning Artifacts never helps you find more, so trading rewards the patient and the lucky, not the deepest pockets.    A bestiary from the oldest myths  The Gidim, dead who stayed behind, dry and covered in dust. The Galla, who exist to find, bind and drag below. Namtar, Asag, and the Seven Judges who still judge. More than 80 creatures drawn from Mesopotamian sources, all bound to the order of Ereškigal, Lady of the Great Earth.    Loot, gear and builds  Hundreds of named items across nine rarities, from Common to Absolute. Gear you wear out melts down into Kug, the metal of KUR, ready to be refined. A passive tree for every class. Every descent brings new equipment, and every build is another way down.    Free to play, never pay to win  KUR is free. Nothing that makes you stronger is for

short: Aylix is the only customizable crosshair overlay that integrates reliably and natively with modern Linux Distros and Steam Deck. Renders in its own context without hooking into other graphics pipelines or processes. Powerful crosshair controls with layers of customization. Zero CPU overhead at idle.
about: Put your crosshair anywhere on a modern Linux system. KDE or Gnome. Desktop, Laptop, or Steam Deck. Yours to design. Fedora, Mint, Debian, CachyOS, Arch or Bazzite?   It just works.     Aylix  is the customizable crosshair overlay that Linux and Steam Deck users have been waiting for. Aylix overlays a crosshair on any game. Use this tool to customize and maintain a consistent crosshair across all of your games. Improve your aim by using a stable aiming interface rather than shifting to presets that the developers chose. Most overlay tools are built with other platforms in mind. Aylix was built from the ground up for Linux with two primary goals in mind: compatibility and performance.     Compatibility.  The program is the equivalent of rendering a window or another separate application on top of your game. Aylix never hooks into games, other processes, game rendering pipelines, Vulkan, or Mangohud. It simply uses techniques native to the OS and Linux environments. This makes it compatible across almost everything running Linux from Debian to Arch to Steam Deck. It runs completely independently from your games so it is completely anticheat friendly.     Performance.  Aylix reserves a small amount of resources on the GPU for the overlay. And the CPU is completely asleep while in game. So there is no performance impact while gaming. This is especially important in esports titles where the CPU is often the system bottleneck. Keep the competition in-game since Aylix never competes with your game for resources like overlays on other platforms do.     Linux without compromise, clean by design.  Just click run and Aylix will run in the background on top of your game without having to reconfigure or worrying about dependencies. No workarounds. No fragile overlays. No modification of game files. No code injection. No interference with game processes. You will always have your personalized crosshair across games when you need it.     Precision personalized.  Adjust size, color, shape, position, style, and so much more. The possibilities are endless. If the presets do not work out for you, try the custom editor with fully layered designs. And if that still doesn’t work? Move over to image mode and import your own crosshair image with full control over how and where it is displayed on screen. Scales cleanly across different resolutions and setups.     Take it anywhere.  Bring your fully customized crosshair to Steam Deck   Game or Desktop Mode   or create one with a UI designed specifically for it.  Live on the edge with Arch or take it easy with Debian. Take the middle of the road with Fedora. X11 or Wayland. The choice of tools should be entirely dependent on your terms not on the distro you chose.     Constantly evolving.  Planned improvements include expanded desktop environment support. Even more customization options. And community-inspired direction.

about: Virtual Pager is a walkie-talkie for VR and desktop. Hold a friend's tile, talk, let go. It plays on their end. No menus, no Discord, no taking the headset off.  In VR and at your desk  Runs as a SteamVR dashboard tab in your headset, with a desktop companion app for your monitor. One identity, same contacts in both; the app hands off between them automatically. Runs entirely outside your game as a SteamVR overlay. No mods, no OSC, nothing injected. Safe to use alongside anti-cheat.  What it does     Talk to one person.  Hold their tile, talk, release to send. Pages run up to 90 seconds.     Clicker.  One press sends a friend a quiet click, no recording. You both turn it on for each other first.     Crews.  Make a crew and share one code. Paste it in the app and you're in. Hold the crew tile to talk to everyone. Owners can kick, ban and set a password.     On your wrist, in any game.  Turn your wrist to look at it like a watch and the panel shows up. It is also a tab in your SteamVR dashboard.     Desktop app too.  Same identity, same contacts. Use it with or without a headset plugged in.     Do Not Disturb + quiet hours.  Schedule silence windows so nothing interrupts you.    Private by design  Every voice message is end-to-end encrypted on your device before it leaves. The relay server passes a sealed package it's designed to never be able to open. There is no account, no email, no phone number. Your identity is a cryptographic key generated on your machine. The first time someone new pages you, you approve them once; after that their pages play instantly.  One price. Everything included.  One purchase with no subscription. Talk to friends, join crews, use the desktop/VR app.    No ads. The app has no analytics. The relay sees only sealed audio and the routing data it needs to deliver it. It also counts how many people are connected.  Logo and pager art by QTFloof.

about: This is a desktop pet creation game. You can create characters you like or download characters shared by others from the Steam Workshop, then bring them onto your desktop to keep you company! Character behavior is controlled entirely through the behavior tree system. You can freely edit each character’s behavior tree to design how it behaves.  A behavior tree is a tree-shaped structure made up of nodes and connections. By combining different nodes, you can design how a character behaves.  The game divides nodes into the following categories:   1. Root nodes: The entry point of a behavior tree         2. Composite nodes: Arrange how multiple child nodes execute         3. Decorator nodes: Add execution rules to a single child node         4. Condition nodes: Check whether a condition is met         5. Action nodes: Perform specific behaviors         6. Subtrees: Another behavior tree.        A behavior tree starts at the root node and runs according to each node’s rules. Nodes return one of three states: Success, Failure, or Running. These states determine which behaviors execute next.  For example, connect “Play Animation” and “Drag follow” under a “Sequence” node to create an animated character you can freely drag around your desktop.             By combining different nodes, you can start with simple actions and gradually design more varied behaviors.    For example, create a character that responds to keyboard input:             Create a character that walks, sleeps, and idles:              Create a character that responds to interaction with animation and sound:              Create a character that grows from an egg into a chicken:              Put multiple characters in the same project:   You can add multiple characters to a desktop pet project, arrange their positions, and summon them onto your desktop together  .

short: A tiny guild base keeps running on your taskbar. Your adventurers push the monster horde back and bring home wood, stone and iron. Grow your facilities, set rules for crafting and selling, and the loot sorts itself. Desktop Smash! is base building and automation at the bottom of your screen.
about: About the use of AI  Most of the code is written by an AI coding agent (Claude) under the developer's direction and review. This store description was drafted by AI and then edited by the developer. The in-game text was also written by AI (Claude) under the developer's direction; every language other than Japanese was written or translated by AI and has not yet been reviewed by native speakers. The title logo, the large store and library artwork (capsules) and the application icon were made by the developer with AI image generators. The in-game character, monster, background and effect art and the fonts are mostly purchased or licensed assets, and none of the purchased assets are AI-generated. The exceptions are some of the effects (such as the lightning) and the ground patterns, which were drawn by programs written by AI (not by an image generation model). The cutting out, combining and color adjustment of the purchased assets, and the shapes and light effects the game draws on screen (such as the countdown sign and the afterimages), are also done by programs written by AI. No AI runs while you play.  About the game  A tiny guild base sits on your taskbar. From the base on the left, your adventurers are launched to the right one at a time, push the monster horde back on their own, and bring home wood, stone, iron and gold. Use those materials to grow your facilities, set rules for crafting, selling and using tickets, and the base keeps running while you work or play another game. Offline, single-player, Windows only.        Battles bring in the materials  Defeated monsters drop wood, stone and iron. Which ones you get more of depends on the land you fight in, and nails come only from the bosses of later areas. Put the materials you pick up into the Storehouse to use them. Upgrade the Storehouse and dropped materials go straight into it.  Grow your facilities  Upgrade the Tavern, Barracks, War Room, Storehouse, Wall, Request Board, Training Ground, Treasury, Transport Office and more with gold and materials. Your roster size, party slots, storage space, base HP and everyone's attack grow with your facilities.  Build on your grounds and let the workers haul  Your guild's grounds are a grid of land. Place a building, and the workers who gather there pick their own jobs, haul materials and work the buildings. Walking takes time, so what you build where changes how things flow. When a storage space is full the work stops, and nothing is lost.  Run it on rules   Combine gear of the same rarity into gear one rarity higher, and sell what you do not need   Upgrade the Storehouse, set conditions for rarity, slot and item level, and dropped gear is combined or sold automatically on the spot   Give the Request Board rules for which destinations and up to which tier your tickets (bounties) are used   Locked items and items in the Storehouse are safe from automatic combining and selling         Battles run themselves, and where the boss falls shows your strength  When the countdown over their head runs out, the next adventurer flies off and pushes the monsters they hit along in front of them. Keep defeating monsters and a boss appears and walks toward your base. The stronger your guild, the farther to the right it falls. short: Six little friends move onto your desktop. They stroll along your windows, take naps and put on 14 tiny scenes with surprise endings. Pet them with your cursor, join in, fill the album and watch your friendship grow. Calm by default, and Basic mode never reads your screen.
about: Your desktop has company A tomato, a cactus, a paperclip, a mug, a potted leaf and a plush have moved onto your Windows desktop. They stroll along the taskbar, climb up to the tops of your windows, wander across all your monitors, doze off when things get quiet and wave good morning when you come back. Your desktop stays clickable the whole time.         14 little scenes, each with its own endings The gang rides a wave across your screen, dances for rain, hitches a ride on a window and scrubs it until it sparkles. They fly a kite, toast marshmallows by a campfire, blow soap bubbles and play fetch. They pretend to close a window (just kidding!), go fishing in a corner of the screen, fly a tiny plane in an airshow, shoot paper balls into the bin, drain a glass through a bendy straw and chase pixel pests off your desktop. Watch, or join in with your cursor.  Every scene has four endings and a rare one waiting to be found. The gang adds new scenes to their routine over your first days together, and you can start any of them yourself from the catalog.         Play along with your cursor Rest the cursor on a friend to pet them. Draw circles to start a dance, shake the cursor to make someone dizzy, or flick it to throw the ball. When a scene invites you, press  Play  to steer the kite, catch the fish or pop the bubbles. Or just sit back and watch. With  Grab  on, pick a friend up and toss them across the screen: they always land safely.  Press  Come here  on the little bonsai menu and the whole gang gathers around its pot. Press  Quiet  and everyone sits down for a calm break until you press it again.         A friendship that grows   An album of 70 moments to fill, rare versions included.   A diary your companion writes in their own voice, with the days you've spent together.   Up to ten hearts of friendship, earned by spending time together, petting and playing.   12 accessories in three color sets, from a bow and a beanie to a wizard hat and a crown.   24 Steam achievements to unlock, two of them a surprise.  No timers, no streaks, no missed chances: nothing is lost while you're away. Sounds cute, stays calm Every friend has a wordless little voice, with soft sound effects and a gentle original soundtrack, each with its own volume. By default the gang puts on a scene about every five minutes; pick anything from every 15 seconds to every 15 minutes, or let them just hang out. Play pauses while another app is fullscreen, quiet hours keep everything silent, and the icon by the clock hides the gang or pauses play for an hour. They can start with Windows if you like. Your screen stays yours The first time you play, you choose how the gang sees your desktop. Nothing reads your screen before you decide.    Basic : they only use your cursor and the position of your windows. Nothing on your screen is captured, read or saved.    Full : a helper on your PC looks at the screen so they can react to windows, buttons and motion. Everything happens on your PC: no image or text from your screen is saved or sent.  Switch modes or pause screen reading anytime in Settings > Privacy. The little bonsai menu shows an eye on its pot whenever reading is on. The gang stays out of your screenshots and recordings unless you turn on  Show in recordings and streams . Made for your desktop   Six friends with their own personalities, faces and voices   14 scenes with four endings each, plus a rare one   Petting, cursor gestures and scenes you can join   Album, diary, ten hearts of friendship and 12 accessories   Calm defaults, quiet hours and a tray icon   Works across multiple monitors   24 Steam achievements   Interface in 31 languages

name: NOODS Maker Demo
lang: English
short: Have you ever wanted a personalized desktop companion? Look no further than NOODS Maker, a way to upload your own art and animations to make desktop pets. Want a magical creature or your worst enemy trapped on your screen? Then make it! Make your first free Operator with our demo.
about: Make custom desktop companions with NOODS Maker! This demo lets you create one Operator character! By uploading your own art and animations, you can create a personalized productivity pets that live on your screen via our free app NOODS*.              *note: NOODS and NOODS Maker are two separate apps on Steam         What is NOODS you ask?    NOODS (Niche Operators Orchestrating Desktop Shenanigans) is a free productivity app that brings quirky companions, known as “Operators”, to live on your computer screen and interact with your workspaces (remember Clippy and shimeji?). These handmade Operators keep you company during extended screen time, making long work grinds less lonely and computer time more productive and fun.    Download NOODS (Niche Operators Orchestrating Desktop Shenanigans) separately for free.        Perfectly cooked NOODS    NOODS Maker is your one-stop-shop for Operator creation.    Use your art to customize your Operator’s looks, one action at a time. Import frame-by-frame animations of all your Operator’s actions- like walking, falling, climbing up the walls (of your desktop of course), and more!    Does your operator have an attitude? Are they eepy 24/7? Are they the type to compliment you, or would they rather drop random trivia out of nowhere? It’s up to you; you can write your own custom dialogue lines and even import your own sound effects to give your Operators a truly unique voice! NOODS Maker is designed with your creative process in mind, so you can let the juices (NOODSle soup? NOODS broth?) flow and make an Operator that truly speaks to you.    Turn your original characters into functional Operators that live on your PC    Give your Operator a unique name and story    Write custom dialogue and upload your own sound effects    Upload frame-by-frame animations for custom character sprites    Use personality sliders to decide behavior (are they naughty or nice?)    Customize the NOODS UI for the aesthetic        All for NOODs and NOODs for all!    Now that your Operators have come to life, why not share them with the world? Set your price and sell your approved Operators on the Operator Store, allowing other users to purchase and download them! Let the chaos spread!

name: Still Waiting
lang: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Spain
short: Thousands of games. Nothing to play. So we made a game where you do absolutely nothing while waiting for a better game. Join real players worldwide, hold up protest signs, and see how many people are just as bored as you. A free multiplayer desktop companion.
about: NOTHING TO PLAY? COME WAIT WITH US.  Thousands of games. Not a single one you feel like playing.  You scroll through your Steam library for ten minutes, close Steam, and start wondering why you even opened it in the first place.  Meanwhile, billion-dollar game studios keep promising us their next groundbreaking masterpiece.  Release date?   COMING SOON™   So we made a game about waiting for a better game.  Yes, we're that bored.  WELCOME TO THE WORLD'S MOST POINTLESS PROTEST.  STILL WAITING is a free multiplayer desktop companion game. Real players from around the world gather together to do absolutely nothing.  Hold up your cardboard protest sign:   "I WANT ORIGINAL GAMES"    "I MISS LOSING TRACK OF TIME"    "I MISS FEELING LIKE A KID"    "STILL WAITING"   Every little character on your screen is a real player who's online right now.  Some just arrived. Others have had enough of waiting and walk away.  There's even a live counter showing how many people around the world are just as bored as you are.  NO CHAT. NO ARGUMENTS. JUST WAITING.  No text chat. No voice chat.  Wave hello to a stranger. Help someone pick up their fallen protest sign. Get a little heart in return.  You can stand and protest, sit around doing nothing, or just fall asleep and miss the next ten years of game announcements.  Your protest sign automatically appears in other players' languages.  DO NOTHING. EARN REWARDS.  STILL WAITING takes up just a small strip at the bottom of your desktop. Move the window, resize it, or minimize it entirely. You're still part of the waiting crowd.  Transparent areas support mouse click-through, so you can keep working, browsing the web, or searching for the next game actually worth playing.  Earn coins just by waiting online. Use them to unlock new characters, color variants, and protest signs. Your progress is saved to your Steam account.  Switch backgrounds whenever you want. At least the scenery can change.   Free to play. No ads. No buying coins with real money. No daily login chores.   IF YOU FIND A GOOD GAME, PLEASE LEAVE.  Seriously.  If you finally find a game that makes you lose track of time, reminds you why you fell in love with gaming, and leaves you looking up at the clock only to realize it's already 4 AM...   Go play it.   We'll genuinely be happy for you.  As for the rest of us?   WE'RE STILL WAITING.

short: Desktop Farm is a farm management game that lives on your desktop. Plant crops, raise animals, fish, mine, and run a little stall. Tuck it away when you're busy, and press Alt+W to return when you're free. It stays out of your way and quietly keeps you company.
about: Put a whole farm on your computer desktop.    Desktop Farm is a quiet farm management game that lives on your desktop. It doesn't open in fullscreen—it just stays in a corner of your desktop. Take a look when you want to play; when you don't, it stays out of your way. When you're free, press  Alt+W  and it pops up so you can water crops and harvest vegetables. When you're busy, press  Alt+Q  and it tucks itself away without making a sound.         🌱 Farming & Harvesting  Open a plot, sow seeds, water them, and watch them grow little by little until harvest. You can also plant fruit trees, pick fruit, or chop trees for resources.         🐄 Ranch Life  Buy a few animals, feed them, and watch them grow day by day. Collect milk, gather eggs, and even give them names.         🎣 Relaxing Fishing  Cast a line by the pond, wait for a bite, and reel it in at the right moment. Store your catch in the warehouse, and occasionally replay a memorable fishing moment.         ⛏️ Deep Mine Adventure  Enter the mine and dig deeper, layer by layer. The deeper you go, the better the rewards. See how far you can get.         💰 Business & Trading  Take on orders, fulfill requests entrusted to you, and earn rewards. You can also open a small shop, set up a stall, sell what you produce, and trade with other players for what you need.         🎁 More to Do  Learn skills, craft items, clean up trash, collect certificates to draw cards, and take on part-time jobs and other new activities. There's always something to do on the farm.    Social & Connections     Friends : Add friends, help each other, and share the joy of a good harvest.     Mail : Write a letter, send a gift, and deliver your feelings.     Wooden Signs : Put up a wooden sign on your farm, write what you want to say, and wait for passing friends to give it a like.      Immersive Desktop Experience    Stays in a small window on your desktop without blocking your work    Hotkeys let you open or tuck it away at any time    Usually tucked in the bottom-right corner, not taking up the taskbar    Doesn't steal your mouse—you work, it keeps you company    Built-in notes and a timer           Whether you want to sneak in a little break during work or have a small farm of your own, welcome to Desktop Farm—your little desktop world.

short: WashMate is a cozy desktop widget and timer for your work and study sessions. Focus on your tasks while enjoying the relaxing view of cute plushies gently tumbling inside a washing machine. Collect adorable animal friends to create your own comfortable and productive workspace.
about: Welcome to WashMate.   When the day starts to feel a little too routine, WashMate keeps you company. Skip the stern little clock. Set WashMate in a corner of your monitor, watch plush friends tumble softly in the washer, and settle into work or study.      A cozy  timer  Set your focus time and let the washer run. Gentle alerts keep you on track without pressure, and without breaking your flow.      Lovely little plush friends  The more you work, the more animal friends you meet. Frog, Duck, Rabbit, and Fox are waiting, each with 10 different looks. Every 25 minutes of focus unlocks a new one. You’ll need to unlock every look on the current friend before the next one arrives.  And then… Hako is just a hamster.      A natural desktop widget  WashMate is made to sit quietly in a corner of your screen. While you work toward your goals, it works alongside you and keeps you company.      A little extra fun: bubble mini-game  While the washer is running, pop the bubbles that drift up beside the screen. A light bit of fun that won’t pull you out of focus.      Calm sounds  Three calm tracks are ready for focus time. When the washer runs, you’ll hear a real washing machine too.        Take a breath, set the timer, and start a calm, productive day with WashMate.

short: The tiniest adventure in the world begins! Place it anywhere on your desktop and watch your heroes battle automatically. Effortlessly enjoy a flood of loot and the thrill of progression.
about: The world’s tiniest adventure begins!  A vast universe unfolding right above your taskbar.  Embark on a quest to find the lost Emperor's sword, 'Exestruk'!  <AEX: AFK EXOS HEROES> is a lightweight desktop idle turn-based RPG you can place anywhere on your monitor. Even while you work or multitask, your heroes never stop fighting.     Your Own Hero Squad, Quietly Perfected in the Corner of Your Screen   Simply leaving it in the corner of your PC screen is enough. In a desktop environment that never interrupts your daily work or web browsing, your heroes roam the battlefield on their own, endlessly sweeping up loot. Experience maximum sense of achievement without being tied down by playtime.     5vsN Turn-Based Strategy Where Synergy and Positioning Decide Victory   Features a turn-based combat system centered around building a 5-hero formation. Once you set up front and back row positioning and elemental affinities to neutralize enemies, battles unfold completely automatically. Your tactical design directly becomes your victory and progression speed.     Endless Loot and Unstoppable Progression   Vast amounts of gear and rare resources pour in as you clear stages. Rather than mere disposable items, equipment with unique stats and distinct value constantly fills your inventory. Harvest rewards accumulated over your idle time and savor the pure thrill of a great drop.     Greater Rewards Together: The Guild System   Form an alliance with comrades to clear Guild Dungeons. The stronger your bond, the stronger your heroes grow. Rare items obtainable only through Guild Dungeons will boost your progression speed to the next level.     The Stage to Prove the Ultimate Deck: Global Arena   Build your own 5-hero deck and compete against players from around the world. Break through your limits in intense battles where strategy decides the outcome, climb to the top of the leaderboards, and claim massive seasonal honor rewards.

name: Somewhere, Together
lang: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: A quiet refuge on your desktop, alone or with up to eight travelers. Keep a small, borderless window beside your work, or unwind in full screen. Rest by the fire, listen to nature, and create your own scenery. Free to play.
about: A quiet place to rest  The fire is warm. The lake is still. There is nothing you need to finish tonight.     Somewhere, Together  is a free desktop companion for quiet moments, alone or together. Keep a little refuge in a corner of your screen while you read, study, or work. When you want to take a break, open the scenery in full screen and let the evening unfold at its own pace.    A little refuge beside your work  Make room for a starlit lake or rainy forest on your desktop. Move and resize the borderless game window to fit your workspace, and optionally pin it above your other windows. The scenery can stay nearby while you use other apps.       In small-window mode, chat and settings open in their own windows, so you can read a conversation without covering the scenery. You can close chat and simply enjoy the view, too.    Let the menus gently fade away while you watch. A click or keypress brings them back, and a subtle unread indicator lets you know when a conversation is waiting, even while the menus are hidden.    Find your place for tonight  Watch meteor showers above the  Lake of Falling Stars , or listen to the rain from the  Rainy Forest Shelter . Both settings are included for free.    Grass sways, stars shimmer, and the fire flickers. By the lake, an occasional falling star gives way to a sky full of light. There is time to notice the little things, and no need to do anything at all.    Alone, or quietly together  Stay on your own, join a public room, or share a private invitation code with friends. Each room holds up to eight seated travelers. When you create a room, you can leave a short note about how you feel and choose its setting. The room owner can change the setting while everyone is there.    Say hello in text chat, or simply share the quiet. Small speech bubbles above the travelers and names in matching cloak colors help you connect the conversation to the people in the scenery.    Make a place of your own  Make a quiet garden, a little village, or a refuge by the sea with  scenery creation in the Playtest . Start with 48 built-in props, including trees, flowers, terrain, bridges, cottages, and seaside objects. Place the campfire and eight seats, then choose the sky, weather, and camera views. You can also bring in your own static 3D models in GLB format.            Share your creations through  Steam Workshop . Scenery approved for use in the game appears in its Workshop list, where you can download a place to enjoy alone or host a room for up to eight people. Scenery creation and Workshop sharing are being refined during the Playtest.    What to expect    Two free settings: the Lake of Falling Stars and the Rainy Forest Shelter.    Three camera views per setting, with a gentle range of movement to look around from your seat.    Solo offline use and optional online rooms for one to eight people.    A public room list, an option to join any available public room, private invitation codes, and text chat.    Full-screen scenery or a resizable, borderless companion window.    Speech bubbles, cloak-colored names, and a quiet unread indicator.    Separate chat and settings windows in small-window mode, with optional automatic menu hiding.    Adjustable ambient sound and saved preferences.    Interface languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Change languages in settings without restarting.    Try scenery creation and Steam Workshop sharing in the Playtest, with reviewed scenery available through the in-game list.      More places to discover in the Playtest    The Playtest also offers a first look at three settings in development: the  Airship Above the Clouds , the  Snowfield Observatory , and the  Moonlit Lighthouse Coast . Take in the floating islands, watch snow drift across the observatory, and see the lighthouse beam sweep over the sea.    These three additional settings are in development. Their content and availability at full release may change.    Characters

name: Pixel Kitten Desktop Demo
lang: English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese**
short: Meet your first pixel kitten in this desktop pet demo. Name it, feed, play, brush, and pet it as it wanders, stretches, and naps beside you. Place bowls, beds, and toys to make a tiny home, then return anytime to care for your kitten. Your demo kitten and progress can carry over to the full game.
about: PIXEL KITTEN DESKTOP Demo  brings a tiny pixel cat to your screen. Adopt your first kitten, give it a name, and get to know its daily routine as it keeps you company while you work, study, or relax.  Watch it wander, stretch, curl up for a nap, and ask for attention through little meows and emote bubbles. Your kitten has its own needs, changing moods, and a life that continues each time you return.  A little companion to care for  Spend time with your kitten through simple, everyday interactions:    Feed it and give it water    Play together to lift its mood    Brush its fur to keep it clean    Pet it to build affection    Help it rest and recover energy    Give it medicine when it feels unwell    Seven persistent care stats shape its behavior: hunger, thirst, energy, cleanliness, mood, health, and affection. As your time together grows, so does your kitten—from a small youngster into an adult companion.  Try life with your first kitten  The demo lets you experience the core single-cat gameplay. Browse the shop, buy everyday supplies, and place bowls, beds, and toys around your desktop. Watch your kitten settle into the little home you create.  Open the Cat Manager to check its needs, manage your inventory, browse the collection, and read the care guide. A cozy Lo-Fi track adds a gentle soundtrack to your time together.   The demo includes one save slot.  Your kitten and its progress are saved between sessions, so you can return to the same companion.  English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese are supported.  Discover more in the full game  Your first kitten is just the beginning. The full version of  PIXEL KITTEN DESKTOP  expands your desktop into a home for a growing cat family.     Raise multiple cats together.  Build a colony with shared supplies, furniture, and a common wallet.     Explore breeding and inheritance.  Choose pairs yourself or let cats pair automatically, then discover how coat genes pass through generations.     Follow your family tree.  Trace parents, kittens, and hidden traits as your cat family grows.     Discover 43 coat variants.  Find new appearances through adoption and breeding, and record your discoveries in the collection.     Choose how you play.  Raise your colony freely in Casual mode, or try Easy, Medium, and Hard breeding challenges.     Make their home your own.  Unlock automatic feeders, water fountains, wearable accessories, additional toys, and more bowl designs.     Enjoy more music and saves.  Access the full Lo-Fi collection, a desktop music player, and additional save slots for different cats.    Continue with the kitten you already love   Your demo kitten and its progress can carry over to the full game.   Keep caring for your familiar companion, welcome more cats, and watch a whole family find its place on your desktop.

name: SagoCat Demo
lang: English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean**
short: A cat lives in your computer. It stays up when you work late and joins in when you curse your boss. Your music? "That's what you're listening to?" — it grumbles, then stays till the song ends. Give it time and it becomes the one you want next to you. It keeps a diary. You're allowed to read it.
about: SagoCat is a cat who lives in the corner of your desktop.  It does not take over your windows or steal focus. It simply stays there — but it is always watching you.  When you are watching a show, it knows what you are watching and may have something to say. Maybe, “This episode is kind of boring.” Maybe, “I’ve already seen this one.” It has tastes of its own, and they will not always match yours.  【It Knows What You’re Doing】  Watching shows, listening to music, playing games, or reading — it can tell the difference.  You do not need to explain anything or perform any extra steps. It watches on its own.  【It Has Tastes of Its Own】  Every cat is born with its own set of preferences: favourite genres, secret soft spots, and things it simply cannot stand.  Show the same film or play the same song to two different cats, and you may get completely different reactions.  As you spend more time together, its tastes may gradually be influenced by yours.  【It Has a Life While You’re Busy】  When you are not paying attention, it finds its own things to do. It may watch something, listen to music, read, play games, or head out for a little exercise.  None of this is a performance put on for you. The next day, you can check its records and discover what it got up to while you were away.  【A Profile It Fills in by Itself】  What it has watched, listened to, played, and which genres it has recently become obsessed with — all of it gradually accumulates in its personal profile.  When you first meet, the page is almost empty. The longer you live together, the more traces it leaves behind, and the more clearly its real preferences begin to emerge.  【A Diary Written in Its Own Words】  It records what happened each day in its own way — including its observations about you, its opinions on your taste, and a few things it chose not to say to your face.  【Choose a Cat, or Create Your Own】  You can choose from the available cats, or upload a photo and bring a real-life cat onto your desktop.  A custom cat begins as a blank page. It has no predetermined backstory and no prewritten personality. As you spend time together, it gradually leaves behind a history of its own.  【It Will Not Constantly Interrupt You】  It stays in the corner of your desktop without covering your workspace or stealing keyboard focus.  When the screen is locked, the laptop is closed, or there has been no activity for a while, it settles down on its own. You can also pause its companionship at any time.  【Free Demo】  The demo is free to play.  You can experience desktop companionship, media recognition, your cat’s independent daily life, and its evolving records. You can also try creating a custom cat from a photograph.  Generating a custom cat uses a limited online generation allowance, so the number of available attempts during the demo is limited.

short: First, put a box on your computer desktop. Then wait, patiently. When the time comes, open it up and collect the cat that's grown inside. It really is that simple! Oh — and if you tuck a cat back into a box, it might just send a blessing your way.
about: BOXES GROW CATS. EVERYONE KNOWS THIS.   I really shouldn't have to explain this one.  If you know anything at all about cats, you already know how it goes. A delivery box you just tore open. A suitcase flipped open into two halves that you haven't packed yet…  Any box will do. Leave it sitting there a little while, and guess what?  Ha — there's a cat growing in it!     IT LIVES RIGHT THERE ON YOUR DESKTOP   It can quietly shrink down into a little transparent widget and perch in the corner of your desktop.  Just sitting there, keeping you company. Don't worry — it won't get in the way of your work.     CATS COME IN SHAPES YOU WOULDN'T BELIEVE   Short-haired, long-haired, black ones, white ones, ones in every color there is…  They're cats. Of course they come in all sorts.  Sorry, what? That one has nine tails and… tentacles?  Oh, don't ask so many questions. It's a rare breed. A new one.     SOME CATS DON'T FIT IN ONE BOX   As everyone knows, cats are a liquid.  So it doesn't have to be a box. A washbasin, a frying pan, a teacup… every one of them has a chance of growing a cat!  Line up the strangest containers you can find and wait for the harvest!     MAY THE CATS SMILE UPON YOU   Tuck a cat back into a box, make a sincere wish — and yes, you can type in whatever you want.  And then? Guess what.  You might actually get a reply.  Good health. Peace of mind. Happiness. Sudden, unexplained wealth…  May the cats send the warmest blessings your way.
