name: Wonder Garden: Desktop Plants
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish
short: A cozy idle garden that lives right on your desktop. Plant seeds, water them and watch real 3D plants grow over days while you work or relax. Every plant is one of a kind: raise butterflies, decorate your shelves and fill an almanac with rare forms.
about: Wonder Garden is a little garden that lives on your desktop, right over your wallpaper and next to the things you do every day. Draw a few shelves, drag a seed from your pouch, and your garden starts to grow while you work, study or just relax.                   Plants grow in real time, over days rather than minutes (your very first one grows up within an hour, to say hello). Water a plant when it asks, and grown plants earn coins for new seeds, pots and decorations. Forget about it for a while? It wilts, but nothing ever dies: water it and it comes back.                   Every seed carries its own genes, so no two plants are ever the same: hydrangeas in twelve colours, lilies with freckles or ruffles, a fern that unrolls copper fronds, a poinsettia that turns red for Christmas by your calendar. Collect every form and colour in the Garden Almanac – and share a seed code so a friend can grow exactly your plant.                   Raise caterpillars into seven species of butterflies that drink from your flowers and bask on the leaves. Brush a mimosa and it folds its leaves; touch a Venus flytrap twice and it snaps shut. Now and then a rare guest drops by – a ladybird, a hummingbird hawk-moth, a snail on a damp night, fireflies on a summer evening.                   Draw shelves anywhere on your desktop and dress them up: dozens of pots in ceramic, stone, brass and rattan, hanging planters, string lights, little books, a sleeping cat, a candle that really flickers, a grow light for faster growth.                   On Windows and macOS your garden lives on shelves you draw yourself. On macOS your plants can also settle right on top of your desktop widgets. The garden rests when nobody is looking and has a power-saving mode for laptops.                     A relaxing idle garden that lives on your desktop – no timers to race, no fail state    14 hand-crafted 3D plant species that grow over real days, each one unique    Seven butterfly species to raise from caterpillars, plus rare garden visitors    Shelves you draw yourself, dozens of pots, hanging planters, string lights and ornaments    A beautiful Garden Almanac of every form and colour you discover    Seed codes to share your favourite plant with friends    Seasonal surprises: a Christmas tree in December, plants that follow the real calendar    Windows and macOS; on macOS plants can also grow on your desktop widgets    Monstera, Dracaena and the bee house are part of the separately sold Supporter Pack and are not included in the base game.

name: Desktop Overlays
lang: English
short: Your favorite character, living on your desktop: above your wallpaper, behind your apps. Pin GIFs to your game, cut out backgrounds in one click, pick from 10 cursor effects, and grab clocks, visualizers, system monitors and a desk pet. Every click goes straight through.
about: Your desktop, but it's yours now Drop a GIF of your favorite character onto your screen. Scale it, spin it, fade it, park it on the edge of your monitor. Then forget the editor exists. It just lives there.  Images, GIFs and videos. As many as you want. Across every monitor you have.  And your mouse never notices. Every overlay is click-through, always. Nothing steals a click, nothing gets in the way of a double-click on a desktop icon.         On your wallpaper. Behind your apps. Every overlay picks a layer.   On top  floats above everything, taskbar included.  Desktop  sits right on your wallpaper and desktop icons, animated wallpapers too, and slides under every window you open. Your character hangs out on the wallpaper. Open a browser and it tucks in behind, like a real part of the desktop.  Colors clash with your setup? Every overlay has a Color section. Pick any hex tint and choose how it lands: Recolor, Hue only, Multiply, Screen, Overlay or Soft light. Then push hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, blur and film grain until it matches. It's alpha-aware, so it recolors the character, not a box around it. Stick it to a game Click any app and pin an overlay to it. Move the window, the overlay follows. Minimize it, cover it, and the overlay disappears with it. Flip on "only when fullscreen" and it only shows up when the game goes big.  A mascot riding the corner of your game. A frame hugging your editor. A reminder that only appears while one specific program is up.  Want it the other way around? "Only show on desktop" keeps an overlay for when you're looking at your desktop, and "Hide on fullscreen" clears the screen whenever a game takes over.         Backgrounds? Gone. Found the perfect GIF but it's stuck in a gray box? Cut it out. Background removal runs right on your PC, no uploads, with a General model for photos and an Anime model for characters and illustrations.  It works on images, GIFs and videos. Animated in, transparent animation out.         It hears your music Overlays can read the sound coming out of your PC and move with every beat. They know what's playing too: title, artist, album and cover art.  Three to start with:    Vinyl Now Playing : a record that spins up when your song plays and coasts to a stop when you pause, with the album art on the label. The card tints itself to match the cover and the grooves catch the beat. Run it as the Classic card, a Turntable with a tonearm that tracks the song, a Compact bar, or Record only.    Lyrics Ticker : synced lyrics lighting up word by word. Keep it as a one-line ticker above your taskbar, switch to two-line Karaoke, or pick Scrolling lyrics for the full song rolling past.    Audio Visualizer : bars along the bottom of your screen with peak caps on top. Or a Ring that pulses with the bass, a smooth Curve, or an LED meter. Color it solid, with a gradient, or straight from the album art. When the music stops, it fades out on its own.          Widgets that feel like part of the room Ready-made bundles you can grab, drop on your desktop and tune from their own settings panel.     Desktop Clock : five faces. Editorial sets the time big in serif with the date between two rules. Or go Analog with a sweeping second hand, a Word clock that lights up its letters, Flip tiles, or a tall Stacked poster. Add other time zones as small clocks next to it.    System Monitor : live graphs for CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network, a per-core load strip, GPU temperature and VRAM, and a bar for every drive's free space. Stack it down the side of your screen, run it as a thin Bar, or shrink it to a Compact readout. It shifts toward a hot color as temperatures climb.    Focus Timer : a Pomodoro timer as a Ring, a Bar or Text only. Start, pause and skip with global hotkeys without leaving what you're doing. Session dots, today's sessions and focus time, and a day streak. Close the app and it keeps counting.    Notification Feed : your Windows notificatio

Designed to blend perfectly into your day, Koimori never pulls at your attention :  there are no pings or alerts asking you to check in. Care for your koi, when you feel like it  Feed your little friends with snacks and  watch them gather around you . Drop algae along the edges of your screen, and they’ll nibble on them whenever they get hungry.  If you keep them happy, you might discover  new and rare kinds of koi...   More features to come!  For the full release, we're preparing:    More  decorative items & snacks ,    A wide range of  koi patterns and shapes ,    The option to let your koi drift  over your windows or behind them all , whichever you prefer,    Nifty focus tools like a playful  pomodoro timer . name: Keeplight
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, German, Thai, Portuguese - Brazil, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Spanish - Latin America, Russian
short: A cozy desktop companion for focus and reflection. Settle into a warmly lit room, use a focus timer, keep a private journal, seal letters for the future, and turn passing time into albums, paintings, and memories to revisit.
about: ☽ After dark, come home to this warm little place.     Choose something you feel like wearing tonight. Write a letter you never have to send. Gently tuck the day into your journal.  Here, you can settle into your own rhythm and slowly find your most relaxed self again.    ─── ✧ ───       ⌂ Feel at home  This is a little world you can step into whenever you like: a woodland path, a welcoming door, a room of your own, the focus room, and the studio. Each corner quietly waits for whatever you choose to do this evening.    A vanity and wardrobe are now in the works. When the game launches, you will be able to choose warm, comfortable everyday clothes for yourself.  It is not about collecting more outfits, and you do not need to dress for anyone else.  It is simply a small ritual of returning quietly as your truest self.    ☕ Follow your own rhythm  When you want to focus, begin with whatever rhythm suits tonight. Start, pause, rest—or simply close your eyes and sit with the timer for a moment. As the night deepens, the room will quietly stay with you.    When focus comes to an end, if a small sense of relief rises in you— "this is enough for today" —then that is enough.          ✉ Write to let go, or to remember  The private Healing Journal is where thoughts come to rest. Write what weighs on you tonight—half-formed worries, things left unsaid, or simply how the day felt. There is no right way to write here. The words do not need to make sense to anyone but you.    You can also write a letter across time: to who you were, who you are learning to be, or who you will become. Seal a letter to your future self until the day you choose; when it arrives, the mailbox will glow softly, waiting until you are ready.    ✦  The Treehole Mailbox  is for thoughts that have nowhere in particular to go. Leave a word, a sigh, or a feeling you don't need to name. It might fade quietly, it might rest here, or it might drift to someone, someday. No expectations. No replies you have to read. Just a place that holds whatever you give it.    ❀ Keep ordinary days close  Moments of focus, fragments from your journal, letters you have saved, and artwork you gradually unlock all gather in the memory album. Leaf through each month's pages and watch the room slowly fill with traces of the evenings you chose to keep. Time becomes a place you can always return to.       ─── ✧ ───     A note from the developer: I am continuing to refine Keeplight's room details and develop an optional feature for anonymous letters that travel slowly. Future letters will travel very slowly, with strong protections for your privacy, your consent, and your safety.      ✦ Add this little home to your wishlist. Whenever you want to return, its light will be waiting for you.

short: A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends! In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your base, and uncover your origins!
about: This is a " co-op idle " " minimal desktop extraction " game you can play with friends!       Gameplay    This is a " co-op-enabled " " minimal desktop extraction " game that sits right on your desktop!    Even though the theme may seem hardcore,  most actions can be performed automatically !    Outside,  fight ,  search , and safely  extract  with  loot  and  experience !    Return to base for  infrastructure !  Enhance characters with devices , store items in the  warehouse , and set out again through the  portal !     Build  and  upgrade  more  buildings ,  recruit  more  NPCs —building an increasingly lively and prosperous base is an essential part of your path to becoming stronger!    Deliver  quests  to NPCs in your base, complete the  story , and embark on a journey to discover your origins in this apocalyptic world!      Free Trading     A small portion of items produced in the game can be freely traded on the Steam Market !    To maintain the stability of the trading market and other online features, we will  strictly ban cheaters  from accessing all online features.    In the future, we will  update with more new gameplay systems that participate in Steam Market trading .      The Beginning of the Story...  In  Dawn City , the "City of Dawn" of human civilization, the event known as " Doomsday of Dawn " occurred.  This super-large modern metropolis gathered most of the world's cutting-edge technology and top magic corporations, but was destroyed overnight under the influence of a mysterious force.  Governments around the world remain silent about it, and many forces coveting this place have gathered here, turning yesterday's prosperous city into a dangerous land full of mysteries and opportunities.  You and your little assistant will also start from Dawn City. On this continent where  modern technology ,  magic , and  gods  exist, you will fight, search, and extract in any  Class  you prefer, gradually grow stronger, build your own base, recruit more companions, and embark on a journey to discover your origins!  "Don't worry! This mission will go as smoothly as always!"       Update Plan  We have planned many exciting updates: character  customizable appearances ,  skins ,  pets , maps with  more gameplay  and  story , more  base-building content , and much, much more!  After full launch, even if content is limited for a period due to production capacity, the game will maintain a  weekly update  cadence. name: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
lang: English**
short: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.
about: Is this the most advanced 3D desktop companion?  I made  Amarillo's Desktop Pets  to be the  most fun  way to showcase and interact with any 3D character. Here characters feel fully alive and responsive, while still giving you an easy-as-pie way to import and customize your own. All the while making them have the best physics you'll find in any desktop companion!            Be physics-crazy  Have fun grabbing a character. Click on them and toss them around. See how their limbs jiggle and twitch. Push them off balance, make them fall, then watch them get back up and keep going.    Or use the Toys included with the game, like the Bonk Toy or the Pin Toy. And I want this side of the game to keep expanding: I'll work on more ways to mess with your characters, more reactions, and more dumb little moments.                Oh, be-ha-ve!  The default behavior of your characters will keep them moving around your screen, climbing onto your windows and causing mayhem.    You will also see them pushing each other, looking at your mouse cursor, chilling, and tripping all the time. The point is not for you to puppet a character every time you want them to do something; I want it to feel like there is a bunch of tiny people hanging around in your PC, each doing their own thing.    But that's not all, I'm also giving you the ability to change their behavior in-game. If you want them to stay in place for a bit, you can do so, but you can also make be more curious about the mouse cursor or climb your windows more often.    Some of the interactions the game offers are grabbing, pinning, head patting, bonking, and more. The Toys and Behaviors options will grow throughout Early Access.            Import, customize, or CREATE  Amarillo's Desktop Pets supports  VRM 0.x , the format used by a huge number of 3D avatar makers and virtual creators. If you are a VTuber with a VRM model, you can load that same character into the game and have them hang around on your desktop instead of leaving them trapped inside your streaming software.    If you are a 3D artist, VRM support means your own characters can be brought into the game too. Import them, customize them, save them, and let people actually interact with the work you made in full 3D, either via the Workshop or privately exporting it as a single file and sharing on your Patreon. And you might find my own official Blender VRM extension pretty useful for this too, just look for "Amarillo's VRM Toolkit" in the Get Extensions menu.    And while the game was conceived for artists to import their own models, non-artists will have the chance to create their own characters using the in-game Character Creator as well. Shape your character's body, tweak their face and expressions, choose a hairstyle, spawn different clothing items, and more. For those so inclined, you can also import your own textures. Transparency is supported.    Here's the basic flow of the Character Creator:    Create or import an unlimited number of characters    Customize their materials, physics and blendshapes    Add your own custom voice lines / subtitles    Save easily swappable presets    Share them in the Workshop, or as .amaCharacter files              Artistic control  I am a 3D artist too, so I care a lot about how a model looks once it is inside a game. Amarillo's Desktop Pets gives you two visual directions you can switch between whenever you want.   Amarillo Shaders  is my own artist-authored shader family, made to present characters with a stylized, semi-realistic look: something a little closer to the classical 3D look I use in Blender. My shaders give you plenty of options for customizing the look of your character's skin, hair and clothes.   Anime Shaders (a.k.a. RealToon shaders)  are for the anime and stylized NPR crowd. They are feature-rich, highly customizable, and made to look great with non-photorealistic 3D characters. Many other games/software use these too, so you might find them familiar.  Switching

name: Antique Dealer
lang: Simplified Chinese, English
short: A turn-based strategy card game of real and fake antiques. Test your knowledge by spotting fakes, if you wish. Adapt to changing demand and prices, take calculated risks, and finish with the most silver. Between games, unwind with idle collecting: 600+ antique cards spanning ten Chinese dynasties.
about: Antiques were once known in Chinese as gudong (骨董), a term meaning “odds and ends.” In his Thirteen Discourses on Gudong, Dong Qichang describes disparate objects from antiquity brought together as a category of their own, calling them gudong. Another interpretation gives each character a deeper meaning: gu (骨), “bone,” represents the enduring essence of the past—just as bones remain after flesh decays—while dong (董) means “to understand.” In this reading, gudong means understanding the essence left behind by the ancients.  In Antique Dealer, you can collect a variety of distinctive antique cards and play strategic card matches.  Collect         The game holds 600 antique cards from ten Chinese dynasties, from the Xia to the Ming, each with six quality levels.  Leave the game running and a new card arrives every half hour, quietly keeping you company.  The collection can shrink to a single small card in a corner of your desktop, so it never gets in the way.  Every card you collect goes on display in your Antique Codex, sorted by dynasty and quality, so you can browse it any time.   Combine   Drag a spare card onto another spare card of the same dynasty and quality to combine them.  When combining Quality I–V cards, you can choose a card of the same dynasty one quality level higher as your target, with a chance to receive a higher-quality card from a random dynasty instead.  Quality VI cards let you choose a card of any quality from the same dynasty as your target.  Play  When you want a challenge, play the built-in card game and outplay rival dealers with what you know about the cards and a sound strategy.   The Book of Changes says: "When it is time to stop, stop; when it is time to act, act. When movement and stillness each come at the proper time, the way is bright."   For an antique dealer, timing is everything. The largest collection does not make you the winner, nor does one profitable deal. When the dust settles, the dealer holding the most silver wins.         Every antique card has a dynasty, a quality rating and a hidden truth: genuine or fake.  Some cards give themselves away, because their dynasty, name and picture don't match.  A genuine card can bring handsome profits, and a fake one is not necessarily worthless.  You can swallow the loss, take your chances on a buyer who does not know better, expose a fake to drive down its dynasty's market, or bluff a rival into taking it off your hands.  The choice is yours.         Each dynasty has its own independent market level.  A card's market value depends on its quality and its dynasty's current market level. Sales, showcases and exposed fakes, in turn, can push that level up or down.  When a dynasty's market reaches its ceiling, its market is sealed, and all cards from that dynasty are confiscated. Once three dynasties have been sealed, the game ends immediately.      Each game consists of multiple rounds, up to a maximum of 15.  Every round has five distinct phases.   The Five Phases of a Round       As night falls and old wares fill the stalls, you come here to stock your shop.  Every Hidden Market merchant has a distinct temperament and their own rules.  Some sell everything at half price; others offer that deal only on the second item. Some move stock fast, selling only in bulk; others let you take a close look before you buy. Some find all manner of excuses to charge you extra; others specialize in buying back second-hand cards from one dynasty.   Each game brings a different mix of merchants. Cheap does not always mean a bargain, and expensive does not always mean a trap. Study the wares, the merchants and your rivals' choices before deciding where to spend your silver.        Objects gathered from across the realm by the authorities are up for auction today. With the right connections, your own wares can find their way into the catalog—and you can get an early look at what is waiting in the storeroom.   Before bidding begins, you can pay to inspe

name: Tiny Patch
lang: Simplified Chinese
short: A cozy desktop gardening game with a transparent, movable garden. Grow radishes and tomatoes, queue tasks for a little gardener, harvest your crops, and trade produce for seeds and fertilizer. Your plants keep growing while you are away.
about: Make room for a little garden on your desktop.  Tiny Patch is a relaxing single-player desktop gardening game. A little round gardener in a straw hat walks between the beds, prepares the soil, waters plants, sows seeds, and carries ripe vegetables to a wicker basket. Move and resize the transparent, borderless garden to keep a small patch of countryside beside your everyday activities.   Grow radishes and tomatoes  Tend three connected beds and watch crops progress through their growth stages. Harvest radishes and collect a second crop from your tomato plants. Queue tasks for your gardener to carry out in order. Plants continue growing while the game is closed.   Enjoy the harvest  Pick individual plants or harvest ripe crops across a bed. Feel the resistance and spring of pulling a radish, then watch your gardener carry the produce to the basket. Store vegetables by crop and quality in your warehouse.   Keep the garden growing  Sell stored produce for in-game currency, restock seeds and fertilizer, and begin another planting cycle. Choose fertilizer that improves crop quality or shortens the remaining growing time.   A little countryside companion  Warm illustrated scenery, gently moving leaves, and the gardener's work animations bring the garden to life. Adjust the window position and size, control sound effects, and keep your progress with local automatic saves.  Designed for Windows desktops and mouse controls. The in-game shop uses virtual currency earned by gardening.

about: A control room for Codex-assisted development  bossMan is a macOS desktop workflow tool for developers who use OpenAI's Codex and want a cleaner way to manage and automate local project work.   For game developers, bossMan can help keep game projects, tooling repos, build notes, implementation plans, and review passes from turning into scattered one-off chat sessions.     Why bossMan?     Highly customizable UI  for your Codex projects to increase efficiency and tune aesthetics.     Assign avatars and voicepack audio playback  to your projects' activity to enhance multitasking and identity.     Tracker system  used to streamline and simplify longterm development of a project itemizing both scoped work and bugs items     Tracker Automation  helps process queued Tracker items through user-configured rules, visible logs, and approval gates for sensitive actions.     Manage local game-dev and software projects  locally and via SSH.      What can I do with the demo?  The bossMan Demo is fully functional as a Codex CLI harness allowing you to prompt your projects using your locally installed and activated Codex CLI. Omitted from the demo are: Tracker System support and Tracker System automation, UI customization, custom voice pack support, custom avatars, and saved prompts are limited to 3.    Built for developers using Codex  bossMan is designed for people who already use, or plan to use, OpenAI's Codex CLI.    Important requirement:   bossMan requires a separately installed and authenticated Codex CLI app. The Steam purchase includes the bossMan desktop application only.  It does  not  include ChatGPT, Codex, Codex CLI, OpenAI API access, AI usage credits, local LLM runtimes, downloadable model weights, or third-party service subscriptions.  To use Codex-based workflows, you must install Codex CLI separately and sign in with your own eligible ChatGPT/OpenAI account. Codex availability, plan requirements, rate limits, pricing, and account terms are controlled by OpenAI and may change independently of bossMan.  bossMan will never ask for or store your ChatGPT password, OpenAI account password, Steam password, payment card information, or third-party service credentials. Authentication must happen through the supported backend's own official authentication flow or through a user-configured local endpoint/API-key flow where applicable.    AI output and automation notice  bossMan may display, organize, summarize, route, and, under user-configured permissions, help apply AI-generated development output from user-configured backends such as Codex or supported local AI runtimes.  AI-generated plans, summaries, code, commands, reviews, and project recommendations may be incomplete, incorrect, unsafe, unsuitable for your project, or incompatible with your licenses and obligations. Review all AI-generated output before using, applying, committing, shipping, or publishing it.  bossMan is intended for software-development workflow management. Project automation is designed around user-selected project folders, visible activity logs, and approval gates for sensitive actions such as command execution, file modification, file deletion, dependency installation, repository-wide edits, SSH/local machine access, or access to credential-like files.  Do not grant bossMan, Codex, or any connected AI backend access to projects, systems, credentials, or repositories unless you are authorized to do so and understand the risks of AI-assisted automation.    Independence notice  bossMan is an independently developed desktop workflow tool distributed through Steam. It is not developed by, endorsed by, sponsored by, certified by, or officially supported by OpenAI, Valve, or Steam. name: DeskForge - Tomato Clock and Advanced
lang: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean, German, Turkish, Thai, Vietnamese
short: A focus Pomodoro that eats a tomato as your session burns down, plus five time tools on your desktop: timer, countdown, stopwatch, alarm with daily and weekday repeats, and a 20-zone world clock. Sits at the very back of the desktop and never steals your focus. Requires DeskForge.
about: Time you can see without opening anything  A timer in a browser tab is a timer you forget. This pack puts a focus Pomodoro and a full set of time tools directly onto your wallpaper, where they sit in plain sight, keep running while you work, and never pull the cursor out of whatever you're typing in.    A Pomodoro you can read from across the room     The tomato gets eaten.  A whole tomato at the start of a focus block, down to a core by the end — six stages of hand-drawn art that tell you how much of the session is left before you've read a single number.     One tomato per round.  Finished rounds are tallied as small tomatoes, six to a row, wrapping to the next row when it fills — the day's work at a glance.     Work is red, rest is blue.  The status text changes colour between the two, and during a break the finished tomatoes pick up a yellow rim — you can tell which mode you're in from across the room.     Your durations, not ours.  Focus, short break and long break are each adjustable from 1 to 120 minutes, with 1 to 12 focus rounds before a long break. Defaults are 25 / 5 / 15 and four rounds if you'd rather not think about it.     Two sounds, not one.  Pick a different alert for entering work and entering rest, from a library of 20. Or let it roll straight into the next block silently.     Sized to your desk.  120 to 480 px, with the countdown digits, the upper and lower zones, and the tomato itself each scalable on their own. Opacity from 30% to fully solid.      Five more time tools in the same pack     Timer  — counts up, so you find out what a task actually costs you instead of guessing.     Countdown  — set a target and watch it fall. Laundry, a call, something on the stove.     Stopwatch  — start, lap, stop.     Alarm  — once, every day, or weekdays only (Monday to Friday). It lives on the desktop, so you can see the next alarm without unlocking a phone.     World clock  — 20 zones covering UTC, Taipei, Tokyo, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Bangkok, Kolkata, Dubai, Moscow, Paris, London, New York, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Sydney, Auckland, Honolulu and São Paulo. Seconds optional. Put three on the desktop and stop doing timezone arithmetic in your head.     It upgrades your sticky notes too  — in the base app each note reminder fires once. With this pack, any reminder can repeat daily, or on weekdays only.      It stays out of your way    Every tool is its own widget. Drag it anywhere, put several on the desktop at once, or keep just the one.    They sit at the very back of the desktop — no taskbar entry, no Alt-Tab clutter, and clicking one never steals focus from what you're typing in.    They keep running while other windows cover them, and they're there again the moment you clear the desk.      Want the desktop to look good too     Dial Packs  — 28 mechanical watch faces across Dress, Pilot, Diver, Sport and Vintage pocket watches, with a smooth sweeping second hand and a carousel that rotates your favourites on a schedule.     Watch Strap Pack  — 16 straps in leather, steel, rubber and NATO nylon, laid flat under the dial or wrapped around it in 3D.      What you need  This is a tool pack for DeskForge and needs the base app. DeskForge turns a cluttered Windows desktop into something you run your day from: drawers that hold your icons and folders, a right-click in Explorer that sends files straight in, real folders opened right on the wallpaper, and live widgets like this one.    Specifications    Windows 10 (version 1903 or later) and Windows 11    Correct scaling at 100%, 125%, 150%, 175%, 200%, 250%, 300% and 400% DPI    Works across multiple monitors    Stored locally — no account, no network needed    One-time purchase, no subscription

name: My Little Farm
lang: English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish*
short: Meet your new desk-side garden! Crops will sprout, ripen, and sway at the bottom of your screen while you work or study. Tend them well and your little farm will bloom with new varieties, colors, and harvests.
about: My Little Farm   My Little Farm is a charming crop-growing simulator that sits right at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company while you work or study. Plant seeds, tend your crops, harvest them, and sell your produce to earn coins — then reinvest in new seeds and expand your fields.   Grow Your Crops  Start with simple vegetables and unlock new varieties as you progress — herbs, fruits, rare plants, and more. Each crop has its own growth cycle and market value.   Tend Your Land  Water, fertilize, and care for your plants to maximize your yield. Neglect them and watch your harvest suffer!   Expand Your Fields  Reinvest your earnings to unlock new crop slots, better tools, and field upgrades that speed up your growing cycles.   Magic Facilities  Deploy special farm buildings — irrigation systems, greenhouses, compost stations — to boost your crops and automate parts of your routine.   Flexible Layout  Freely drag and resize your farm strip. Place it anywhere on your screen.   A New Kind of Desktop Companion  The bottom-of-your-screen genre has blossomed into one of the most beloved niches on Steam, and My Little Farm is right at home in it. If you've spent time with Rusty's Retirement — the beloved idle farming game that helped define this whole category — you'll feel immediately comfortable here. Like Rusty's Retirement, My Little Farm is built for the multitasker: your crops tick forward whether you're writing a report, browsing the web, or watching a stream. Fans of Ropuka's Idle Island, Cornerpond, My Little Life, Nanomon: Virtual Pet, and Milly's Meadow will also find a lot to love. Each of those games found a loyal audience by trusting that players want something gentle happening at the edge of their screen — and My Little Farm delivers exactly that feeling, with the satisfying loop of planting, growing, harvesting, and reinvesting.   Cozy Vibes, Serious Depth  The cozy gaming wave has produced some unforgettable titles, and My Little Farm draws from the same well. Players who enjoy Stardew Valley's low-pressure farming loop, the hand-crafted warmth of Fields of Mistria, or the pastoral simplicity of Farm Together will feel right at home watching seedlings sprout across their taskbar. There's something here for fans of Fae Farm's gentle progression, Sun Haven's crop variety, and Coral Island's laid-back harvest cycle too — except all of it plays out in a compact strip you never have to alt-tab into. My Little Farm respects your time the same way these games do: every session, however short, moves something forward.   For the Idle and the Incremental  If you're drawn to games that reward patience and compound growth, My Little Farm belongs in your library alongside Tiny Pasture, Village Tale, Idle Waters, and Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi. Like those titles, progression here is measured and meditative — there's always a next crop to unlock, a next upgrade to chase, a next field to open. Desktop Cat Cafe, Maltese's Fluffy Onsen, Not Monday Cafe, and Bao Bao's Cozy Laundromat players will recognize the same satisfying rhythm: small decisions, visible results, a world that quietly keeps growing even when you look away.   Management and Simulation Fans Welcome  Beyond the pure idle crowd, My Little Farm speaks to anyone who enjoys light management and resource loops. If Tavern Keeper's steady economic rhythm appeals to you, if you've built farming empires in Farming Simulator 25 or Rune Factory 5, or if you spent dozens of hours optimizing crops in Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar — you'll appreciate that My Little Farm distills those loops down to their most satisfying core. There's no combat, no pressure, no fail states. Just a field, seeds, sunshine, and the quiet pleasure of watching a plan come together.   Crafting, Building, and Atmosphere  My Little Farm shares its spirit with the wave of atmospheric cozy games that have captured players in recent years. Tiny Glade showed that a game can thrive on pure aesthetic plea

name: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge Demo
lang: English, Polish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Czech, Indonesian, Portuguese - Portugal, Thai, Vietnamese, Hungarian
short: Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. You tap the keys, he swings the hammer. Usually it's horseshoes or cauldrons, sometimes something epic, like a legendary sword. His wife Brygida sells it all in their shop. Together, work goes faster and feels better.
about: YOU TYPE. HE FORGES. Brokk lives just above your taskbar, where he runs a forge and works whenever you do. You write emails or code, and he forges items. Every key you press brings his hammer down. When you type quickly, the furnace glows white-hot and Brokk gives it his all. When you take a break, he catches his breath too. A FORGE THAT KEEPS YOU GOING WITHOUT GETTING IN THE WAY The game is designed to stay out of the way while you work. Typing fuels the forge, and Brokk keeps pace with you. Open the panel when you want to buy an upgrade or check on the shop, then get back to what you were doing. You can move the forge, resize it, tone down the effects or turn off the sound. LEGENDS ARE FORGED FROM ORE It starts with ore, then ingots hammered out one by one, and finally a finished piece: a dagger, a cauldron, a horseshoe or whatever the shop's customers have ordered. Sometimes the metal gleams and something legendary takes shape: Szczerbiec. Excalibur. Mjolnir. There are 49 item patterns across five rarity levels. You can browse your collection in the display cabinet.          A look at the full game's collection, from everyday tools to legendary mithril treasures.  HIS WIFE BRYGIDA RUNS THE SHOP    Brygida sells whatever comes off the anvil. Some customers buy what's on the shelves. Others place special orders and pay extra. You decide how freely the forge spends on ore for new items, from inexpensive copper to the best metal you can afford.         THE FORGE PAYS FOR ITS OWN UPGRADES The gold you earn goes back into the forge and shop. Buy Brokk a heavier hammer or better bellows, and Brygida a new sign to bring in more customers. A whetstone improves your chances of forging rarer pieces, while counter decorations raise prices in the shop. You can speed up forging, increase earnings or save up for the next metal. Just leave some gold for ore.  As your equipment improves, the little workshop changes with it. You can also give the forge a different look by choosing a workshop style.         FROM COPPER TO IRON Start with copper. In time, you'll unlock bronze, then iron. The goal of the demo is to forge your first iron item. Once you get there, you can keep forging and collecting with no time limit.   Your progress stays with you.  If you choose, you can carry over your progress from the demo once the full game is released. You'll keep your collection, forge and shop upgrades, and the resources you've gathered. IN THE FULL GAME After iron, you'll unlock steel, silver, gold and mithril. If you'd like to keep building up the forge, add My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge to your wishlist and follow the game.   Privacy:  The game counts key and mouse-button presses. It does not record the text you type. Gameplay works offline.

name: Infinite R: Idle Racing
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: "An idle racing management game tailor-made for second screens. Perfect for 'desktop slacking,' watch your car auto-race while you work. No driving required—step behind the scenes as the boss to tune cars, manage drivers, and experience the pure joy of motorsport management!"
about: nfinite R: Idle Racing   is a racing idle management game tailor-made for car enthusiasts and those who love to sneak in a little gaming while working.  Here, you don't need to tense up and focus on hitting the perfect racing line. Instead, you step into the shoes of a team's gold-medal tuner and mod shop boss. The game perfectly supports  [Desktop Idling]  during work hours, with an adaptive window that sits comfortably at the bottom of your screen. While you are typing code, writing reports, or browsing the web, your exclusive ride is automatically speeding along the edge of your screen with its engine roaring—continuously generating income for you without ever delaying your actual work.  Say goodbye to the heavy grind and tense nerves! No stressful inputs are required. Check in occasionally, click a few times when you're free, and just enjoy the fun of the game.             Development Plan         Tuning & Simulation Management   Start from a dilapidated garage and a beat-up old street racer, and gradually revive your custom car empire. Say goodbye to tedious stat crunching; the game offers the pure soul of car modification. Unlock more modification kits as you level up, which not only drastically boosts your car's performance but also evolves its badass appearance. Hire and manage workshop employees to build an efficient and lightning-fast workflow!            Intense Idle Racing   The cars drive fully automatically on idle throughout the race, never demanding your core focus. During your breaks, you can choose to actively intervene—by training racers, unleashing exclusive skills at critical moments, and pulling off extreme overtakes. Instantly take control of the race's pacing and use your strategy to significantly boost your win rate and tournament earnings.           Deep Modification System   Satisfy your ultimate craving for machinery and speed! Dive deep into your vehicle's powertrain and chassis tuning, from engine enhancements to transmission system upgrades. Not only are there hardcore internal performance boosts, but there is also a massive variety of widebody kits, custom spoilers, and personalized wheels for you to mix and match. Every meticulous tweak allows your race car to show off a truly unique stance on the track.           Collect More Vehicles   As your garage continues to expand, you will have the opportunity to unlock and collect a massive roster of classic race cars across different styles. Continuously enrich your garage collection, assign the most suitable cars to compete based on specific track requirements and personal preferences, and watch them roar past on your secondary screen.           Rich Character System   Recruit and train highly talented racers and tuning shop mechanics. Every driver has an exclusive driving style and unique skills that can save the day on the track; meanwhile, excellent workshop staff and operations specialists can massively improve prep efficiency and offline income. Strategically balance your team lineup to keep your crew running like a well-oiled machine.           Dynamic Weather System   Your racing journey will never be monotonous. The game introduces a rich, dynamic weather system. Whether it's a crystal-clear street or a neon-lit rainy night, the game delivers completely different visual atmospheres, making every idle lap feel immersive and fresh.           Diverse Scene Selections   From bustling urban city streets with heavy traffic to winding mountain hairpin turns, and all the way to endless coastal highways. The diverse track landscapes are not only a visual feast but also pose unique challenges to your vehicle's grip, horsepower output, and your driver's skills.           More Content Coming Soon   More classic vehicles, hardcore modification parts, and brand-new maps are continuously in development. If you like this game, please be sure to add it to your  [Wishlist]  to support us. Your support is a massive motivation for our independent develop

about: PC Companion is a transparent desktop companion experience where a living character stays on your screen while you work, play, and browse. She reacts to your presence, responds through dialogue and interactions, and can be engaged through an in-game interface layered directly onto your desktop.  But there is one rule:  Each player gets only one heroine.  And you cannot change her… unless you discover the secret.  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   INTERACTIVE COMPANION   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  Your character is not just visual — she reacts to your actions.  • Talks and greets you    • Responds to your activity    • Reacts to games installed on your PC    • Suggests content based on your interests    ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   GAME INTEGRATION   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  Your companion connects with your gaming experience.  • Detects installed games    • Suggests related YouTube content    • Adapts to your playstyle  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   RECORDING GAME STATISTICS AND HIGHLIGHTS   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  • Voiceover of some of your actions in CS2/Dota2  • Logging of game statistics for viewing  • Gives achievements for some actions      ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   CARD DROP SYSTEM   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  Interact with your companion and earn collectible rewards.  • Unlock cards through activity    • Rare and special variants    • Tradable collectibles (Steam Market ready)    • Hidden and secret cards    ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   UNIQUE CHARACTER SYSTEM   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  This is what makes the game different.  • One character per PC    • Permanent choice    • Secret heroine unlock system    • Hidden mechanics to discover    ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   LIVING WORLD   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  Your companion reacts to the environment.  • Time of day    • Your activity    • Atmosphere and behavior change over time    ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   PERSONALITY & ATMOSPHERE   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  Each heroine has her own personality, behavior, and hidden story.  The more you interact — the more you uncover.  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━   AND MORE   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  • Future updates with new features    • Possible mini-games    • New collectibles and secrets    Your companion is always watching…  …are you ready to discover everything?  The current build focuses on the core desktop companion experience: transparent on-screen presence, interactive menus, character reactions, collectible inventory systems, profile customization elements, and Steam-connected progression features. This is not a traditional full-screen game loop — it is designed to function as an always-visible companion on your desktop.  As you interact, you can unlock and manage collectibles, open the inventory, customize parts of the experience, and use built-in interface panels without leaving the desktop environment. Steam integration is included for progression-related systems available in the current build.

name: Bookmark Hero
lang: English
short: Bookmark Hero is a fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and instruct your hero with queued tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.
about: Bookmark Hero is a high-fantasy, peripheral-idle RPG set in the vast kingdom of Arshrein. Play from a bookmark-sized window on the side of your screen and command your hero indirectly by giving them tasks. Watch as they explore lands, conquer monsters, hone skills, craft gear and weapons, and embark on quests. Even as you work, their legend unfolds.                  The world of Arshrein is filled with diverse regions and points of interest. Venture forth to uncover new opportunities, stories, and riches — but be wary. The further you travel, the more dangerous the roads, and the greater the quests that wait. As you level up your skills, you’ll be ready to take on tougher, more legendary work.          Create a hero that fits your style with multiple races, hairstyles, and visual customization options. Gear defines both your appearance and your bonuses. Whether you aim to become a master wizard, a hardened warrior, or a precise ranger, crafting and equipping the right items is key to shaping your hero’s strengths.         Bookmark Hero keeps to a small window on the left or right of your screen, including across multiple displays, with room to play and room left for everything else. Tell your hero to chop wood or fight goblins, and they manage their own inventory and carry on until you say otherwise — while you stay on your work, a browser, a chat, or even another game.          Every kind of work can be taken all the way to mastery. Send your hero into battle and let the blade, the bow, and the staff each become their own path. Set them chopping in the woods, or send them deep into the mines. Skin the game they bring down, and forage the plants along their path. Become a smith and forge the weapons they carry. Fletch their bows, work their leather, and tailor their cloth. There is alchemy to brew, and books to bind. Become a hunter or farm the land. Cast a line until your hero is a master fisher, or cook until they are the best chef in the land.

short: Toy Worlds Atlas is a sandbox game where you play with colours to solve riddles and discover secrets. Each level explores a philosophical topic and subverts expectations with new colouring mechanics. Made to inspire thought, this game offers a relaxing cognitive reset.
about: CREATE YOUR OWN TOY WORLD   Toy Worlds Atlas  is a  sandbox game where you play with colours to solve riddles and discover secrets. Each level explores a philosophical topic and subverts  expectations with new colouring mechanics. Made to inspire thought, this game offers a relaxing cognitive reset.          TOY PHILOSOPHY  The game is a playground that fosters thought, imagination and creativity through playful interactions. It refers to the fact that living beings perceive reality differently: minds toy with subjective pictures of the shared world. Toy Worlds Atlas imagines subjective worlds materialized, and invites you to decide how they would look like.          DELIGHT YOUR CURIOSITY  Discover philosophical ideas transformed into colourful playthings, inspired by thinkers ranging from Heidegger and Deleuze to Dennett and Chalmers. Enhance your erudition and reflect on some of the deepest questions through short, playful, and intellectually satisfying puzzles.          SCHOLASTIC DAYDREAMING  A strong surreal art style inspired by the nostalgic visual language of 1990s illustrated encyclopedias and educational atlases.          PHENOMENOLOGICAL ORANGERY  A desktop companion mode (work in progress): a garden where coloured creatures gather and interact in curious, unexpected ways. Leave the game running while you complete office tasks. Play with friends in local coop, compare your creations, and make them interact!            MAIN FEATURES     Unique mechanics in every puzzle.   Toy Worlds Atlas  transforms multiple genres into colouring pages, from deduction and alchemy to collaging and platforming.     Creative replayability . Each puzzle can be solved in multiple ways, producing new colour combinations and outcomes.     Desktop companion mode  for work sessions.     Genuine philosophy . Turned into playful colouring puzzles by a philosophy researcher and game designer.     Play smart, not hard!  You decide how deeply you prefer to engage with serious themes.     Mindful pastime . Take a meaningful break from routine.     Juicy and bizarre interactions.  You never know what might happen on your next click.    FULL GAME WILL INCLUDE    20-30+ colouring pages.    More interactions and secrets in Desktop Companion mode    Deeper secret content

name: Heroes For Hire - Guild Micromanagement Simulator
lang: English**
short: You've joined a guild before, right? So, where's the trouble in managing a guild of your own, too? Use the GuildOS system to guide your heroes, raid some dungeons, and grow your guild to rise from the bottom of the ranks right up to the top in Heroes for Hire!
about: Heroes For Hire is an incremental business management game focused around building a dungeon raiding guild from the bottom up with the GuildOS system.       Managing a guild won't be easy as it sounds, though! When running any business, you already have to worry about your employees, your customers, your finances and your living quarters.   Just imagine what could go wrong when you start bringing dungeons, fantasy and magic into the picture, too!     Do you have what it takes to run the number one guild in the county? If so, you can prove it by competing in tournaments and competitions with rival guilds to determine who really is Raiders Digest's top guild of the week!               Employees are the life blood of any business. After all, how are you going to raid dungeons when you don't have any dungeon raiders on the payroll?             Recruit and manage a team of heroes with their set of skills, personality and stats to help them during raids and tournaments.     Craft, buy and find equipment and weaponry that can tie-in roles and niches for the team and guild.     Make sure to keep the needs of your employees well met by adjusting their wages, schedule and living quarters.               Set up your heroes with the best equipment and items you can find, and go and let them explore some dungeons on their own when they're ready!             Make and upgrade your heroes' equipment using materials scavenged in raids and on gathering missions.     Craft the necessary tools needed to help your heroes out on their adventures, such as potions, bombs and relics.     Build the furniture needed to turn your guild from a shack to a castle fit for a hero of any calibre.                  Of course, there's more to running a guild than just the heroes and finances—there's the guild itself, too!            Expand your guild's living quarters with furniture that has been bought, found and crafted.     Raise your guild's reputation to attract more guest merchants and services with stringent housing requirements.     Build more rooms to improve the quality of life for your heroes, and unlock some upgrades at the same time.          Remember, there's always room to grow and expand your guild! So...

about: Story of You  is a practical desktop companion tool. Designed for anxious individuals and others in need, it provides quiet, warm support during your most vulnerable and anxious moments.  The interface support English and simplified Chinese, but the typing part supports typing in most languages.        Medieval Wizard-Style Desktop Companion  A retro medieval-style notebook, quill pen, and cauldron add a touch of ritual atmosphere to study and work, bringing a good mood to your tasks! The size of the decorations can be freely adjusted, and the floating animation effects can be toggled on and off, allowing you to customize your desktop companion experience.        Mood Notebook Feature  Click the desktop pet anytime to write diaries or moods in the notebook. When feeling anxious and uneasy, pour out your feelings and complex emotions in writing. Through the process of writing, you can see your inner self clearly, sort out your emotions, calm down, and no longer feel anxious or sad. The desktop floating companion is prominent and convenient, reminding you not to act impulsively under negative anxious emotions, but to write down your thoughts first and face problems calmly.        Highly Customizable White Noise & Music  Whether it's simply for companionship during study and work, or as a sedative during anxious times,  Story of You  offers highly customizable white noise and music features, providing you with a quiet and soothing background ambiance.  White noise includes:    Nature White Noise    Rain sounds  Ocean  Insects  Farm ambiance  ... ...    Life White Noise    Writing sounds  Fireplace sounds  Café ambiance  ... ...    Zen White Noise    Bell sounds  Singing bowl sounds  ... ...  In addition to white noise,  Story of You  also includes  multiple lo-fi and jazz-style light music  that can be freely selected and matched according to your mood and occasion.  Unlock Features  Writing a certain number of notes unlocks more songs. At the same time, reaching a certain number of specific mood notes also unlocks more white noise, providing richer music combination options.  Supports Steam achievements, unlocking more achievements through continued use.

During normal movement, your corgi treats the house as part of the desktop environment, walking around it naturally and occasionally heading toward the doorway for a short visit.  You can also customize the house to better match your desktop. Choose from multiple house styles, including Base, Green, Pink, and Red, and set the doorway to face left or right. Your chosen style, door direction, and placement are saved, so the house stays exactly where you left it. lang: English, Vietnamese
short: A cozy incremental game about a hungry cat and its little pond. Grow your pond, collect fish and curious creatures, unlock new skills, discover rare relics, and watch your tiny ecosystem come to life.
about: A Little Pond. A Hungry Cat. Lots of Fish.   A Cat’s Little Pond  is a cozy incremental game about growing a tiny pond into a lively little ecosystem — all for one very hungry cat.  Start with a quiet pond and a handful of fish. As your cat collects more Mass, you can unlock and upgrade new spawners, bringing more fish, insects, treasures, and other curious creatures into the pond.  🌿 Grow Your Little Pond  Place and upgrade different spawners around the pond, from lily gardens and reed patches to sunken treasure and fallen logs.  Each one adds something new to the ecosystem, gradually turning an empty pond into a busy little world full of things to discover.  🐱 Let the Cat Do Cat Things  Your cat isn't just here to look cute.  Unlock new skills and upgrade them as you progress. Swipe at nearby creatures, pull things closer, toss fishbones, make waves, slam the water with your tail, and find increasingly effective ways to collect everything the pond has to offer.  🐟 Discover & Collect  The pond is home to more than ordinary fish.  Discover different fish, creatures, items, and relics and fill out your collection. Some things are common sights, while others may require a little luck — or the right conditions — to appear.  ✨ Find Relics  Treasure can contain relics ranging from simple pond trinkets to extremely rare artifacts.  Relics can improve your Mass gain, increase your chances of finding rare loot, speed up your spawners, or provide combinations of powerful bonuses.  Find them, collect them, and decorate your pond with your favorites.  🌦️ Watch the Pond Change  Your pond keeps moving even when you're not doing much.  Day turns into night. Weather changes. Creatures swim around, insects visit the water, plants sway, and new things appear as your pond grows.  There is no need to rush.  Upgrade your pond, discover new things, watch the numbers go up, and enjoy hanging out with your cat.   It's just a cat and its little pond.

about: TimeslotTV  is personal media software that organizes your video, audio, and image files into a simulated television experience — complete with numbered channels, a live-style program guide, and authentic TV controls.     Note: TimeslotTV does not include, stream, broadcast, provide, host, share, or distribute content. All playback comes from local files on your own computer.      Content plays continuously and in sync, like a real broadcast: when you change channels you join the stream mid-program rather than starting from the beginning. Each channel keeps its own running timeline, so your station keeps up the simulated broadcast whether you're watching or not. Don't worry, you can still skip forward and back if needed.             Turn your media library into a TV station   Point the Channel Scanner at your media folders and it builds out channels based on your existing folder structure. You can then view and fine-tune your lineup using the live Program Guide. See something you like in the guide but that isn't currently playing? No problem — drag the timeline or skip directly to any media block.                       Controller Options    Navigate the media player with keyboard & mouse, gamepad, touch, or IR remote control, depending on your setup.      Effects Mode    Add screen curvature, scanlines, black & white, and other live filters.             PIN Lock    Lock the app on startup or lock individual channels behind a 6-digit PIN, with an optional "scrambled signal" effect.             Mini-Games    Adjust rabbit ears and VHS tracking settings using your gamepad.             Audio Player    Turn music folders into their own stations, with track info and an optional spectrum visualizer.             Photo Slideshow    Turn images into slideshow channels, with configurable duration, order, and transition effects.

name: MYTHOS: Local Media Intelligence
lang: English
short: Find your photos and videos by describing them. Search text in images and speech in videos, browse visual matches and edit in one local gallery, with Mythy on your desktop to help. Indexing and search run on your PC. No MYTHOS account required.
about: You have over fifty thousand photos and videos. You need one. MYTHOS indexes the folders you choose on your own computer, then lets you search them by scene, text or spoken words.         Search it like you'd describe it  Type  a morning walk in a forest  or  the receipt from the hardware store  and MYTHOS looks for it by what is in the picture, not by what the file happens to be called. Filter by type, folder, date, album or tag; sort by best match.            Meet Mythy   Mythy is your assistant, and she lives on your desktop rather than in a chat window. Click her and ask in your own words. She searches your library, shows what she finds in the gallery and answers in a speech bubble beside her head.  She can upscale pictures, remove backgrounds, trim borders, copy files and run long jobs in the background. Nothing changes until you press  Do it :  See all  shows every file first, and  Undo  takes it back.  She runs on the same local AI as the rest of MYTHOS, so she needs a model download and a capable graphics card. Prefer a plain window? Chat Lab, built into the gallery, runs the same assistant.       Find text, speech and look-alikes     Text in images  — screenshots, documents and signs, read on your PC and searchable.     Speech in videos  — transcribe speech locally, search the transcript and jump to a matching moment.     Look-alikes  — browse pictures ranked by visual similarity, and clean up near-duplicates.     Characters  — tag characters yourself and find matching images from your examples.                Organised without the busywork    Automatic tags and descriptions.    Albums you curate, and smart albums that fill themselves from a search.    Sort a chaotic Downloads folder into tidy folders, with a preview first and one-click undo.           A studio built in  The photo editor opens in Quick mode: looks, light and colour sliders, one-click background removal, AI erase and AI upscale. Switch to Studio for layers, masks, brushes and text.            Private by design  MYTHOS indexes only the folders you choose. Your photos and videos are read and indexed on your computer, and indexing and search never upload anything. The catalog, thumbnails and AI models live in your local application data folder.  The internet is used only for things you ask for, each clearly marked: downloading the AI models and tools a feature needs the first time; Web Assist, which sends the words you look up to reference sites; and reverse image lookup, which sends a small copy of one picture only when you press it. Settings lists all of this under What leaves this PC.  MYTHOS has no advertising, no analytics and no account of its own. Once the models you want are downloaded, it works offline.  Good to know    Windows 10 (22H2) or 11, 64-bit. An NVIDIA graphics card with 8 GB of video memory is recommended. See the system requirements for memory and storage; performance depends on the models and hardware you choose.    Indexing a large library takes time. It runs in the background and can resume; new files and model changes can add processing work.    Your library stays where it is: MYTHOS never moves or changes a file unless you ask it to.    Steam Cloud is not used: the catalog of a big library runs to gigabytes and stays on your PC.      The video editor is a multi-lane timeline for clips, overlays, titles and audio. Trim, split and merge, then export for widescreen, vertical or square. AI upscaling and smoother frame rates run on your own graphics card.

about: Limitlesscape turns your desktop into an endless canvas that pans and zooms from 1% to 2000%. It sits  behind your windows, where your wallpaper used to be, and your real files, folders and shortcuts live  on it as cards you place yourself.       ●  Your real files, where you put them.  Drag them in from Explorer. Group a project in one corner and push last year into the distance.  ●  Regions  you can name, so every part of your life gets its own place on the map.  ●  Warp points  on Ctrl+1 through 9 take you straight to a place. Hold M for  Universe Peek  and the whole board becomes a constellation of everything you own.  ● Press Home to fit everything in view, and step back through where you've been with Ctrl+0 or the mouse's back button.               ●  Connections  in 7 styles to wire related cards together. Linked cards move as one (on by default).  ●  Live Folders  that mirror a real folder and keep themselves sorted, and  sticky notes  in six papers.  ●  49 auto-arrange patterns:  a pile becomes a spiral, a wave or a heart in one click.  ●  Spotlight search  on Ctrl+F, plus  undo and redo  for moves, resizes, deletes, edits and connection changes.                 ●  Wallpapers that move:  solid, gradient, image, GIF or your own video, plus 31 generated, animated styles across four families (psychedelic flows, a drifting moon surface, living maps and orbital planets). Image, GIF and video wallpapers can each have a separate night version that swaps in after dark.  ●  19 widgets  that live on the board: clocks, a calendar, a countdown, a stopwatch, a pomodoro, a checklist, a photo frame, drive space, world clocks, color swatches, snippets, board stats, and a Stardust Mine.  ●  70 grid styles , from graph paper to a starfield;  24 zoom indicators ;  8 animated border effects .                 And you're not alone on it. More than 500 pixel companions, each animated frame by frame, across 27  families: the deep-water ones, the feathered ones, the court of hollows, the yokai, the small gods.  Nine temperaments. Some are homebodies, some are showoffs, and a few are sleepyheads.  You choose your first one yourself, from a wall of faces, and they arrive on your canvas with a free  Stardust Mine beside them.  After that they get on with it. They wander your board and sit near whatever card you've been using.  They nap in piles on your folders. They chase a ball, race each other and play hide and seek behind  your files. They make friends and rivals. They dig up treasure: a pebble, a ribbon, a star shard, and  once in a while something buried and worth having. After dark one of them is appointed night watchman.  They tend the campfire until dawn, then hand you the Stardust they gathered.  When a companion sleeps, a bubble appears above them with a scene moving inside it. It's not a  symbol; it's an actual little animated place. Click it to open it full size, and in many dreams you  can step inside as any companion you own.  Stardust comes from using your board and from your Stardust Mine, which keeps working even while  Limitlesscape is closed. It fills in about sixteen hours and then waits for you; it never overflows.  Spend Stardust to welcome more of the roster, buy games and camp gear, and open more roaming slots.  Some companions can't be bought at all. They carry a deed instead, something you have to actually do.  There are no microtransactions. Stardust can't be bought with money.  The built-in Character Workshop (not Steam Workshop) and its character editor let you make  companions of your own and remix the look of one you have. You can also import character packs  from files.               ● When nothing on it is moving, the canvas paints no frames at all. Not a low frame rate; none.  ● The animated wallpaper pauses while a fullscreen game or app covers all of your monitors (on by default).  ● Win+Shift+D hides or shows the canvas from anywhere.  ● Optional Start with Windows. One copy runs at a time.

name: Poordle

short: A little homeless poodle just wants a home. Every key you press and every click you make helps him build one, bucket by bucket, tent by tent. No random loot, no microtransactions. Just type, click, and watch your poodle build a life.
about: Meet Poordle. He used to have a home, and now he doesn't. All he has left is a bucket and a bit of hope.           Every time you type or click anywhere on your computer, Poordle headbutts his bucket and earns a coin. It doesn't matter what you're doing. Writing an email, chatting with friends, grinding through spreadsheets, playing another game. Poordle is right there with you, working just as hard as you are.         Those coins go toward rebuilding his life. His tent slowly turns into a box, then a house, then something even bigger. His old rusty bucket gets upgraded right alongside it.         Poordle doesn't ask for much. He just wants a home, and you're the one helping him get there.         How It Works  Poordle tracks your keyboard and mouse input system-wide, not just inside the game window. Every headbutt earns one coin, no luck involved, and those coins go straight toward his progress. His home and his bucket both level up over time, and every tier is earned through real progress, nothing hidden behind a loot roll or a random drop.  Why Poordle Is Different  A lot of desktop companion games throw random rewards at you and hope you get attached. Poordle skips that entirely, no gacha, no pay-to-skip, no microtransactions of any kind. Every tier you reach, you reached because you earned it.  Always With You  Minimize Poordle and he tucks into your system tray, still counting quietly in the background, ready to show you how far he's come the moment you bring him back. He'll show you the local weather right on your desktop, and if you're ever in the mood for a bit of company, he's always up for some small talk.  Buy Once, Own Forever  Poordle is priced at $1.99, one-time purchase, no in-app purchases, no ads, no paywalls. What you see is what you get, forever.  Share Your Progress  Come back daily to keep a streak going for small rewards along the way, and snap a screenshot of Poordle's current setup, house and bucket both, whenever you want to show it off.  Compete With Others  A global leaderboard is planned for the full release, so you'll be able to see how your progress stacks up against other players. It's not included in the demo yet.  Try the Demo First  A free demo is available so you can try Poordle before you commit. Players who try the demo get an exclusive bonus look for Poordle's house and bucket when the full game launches.       Key Features    Track your typing and clicking as real, meaningful progress    20 tiers of visual upgrades across two progression paths, with more added after release    No rarity gacha, no randomness anywhere in progression    Minimizes to system tray and keeps tracking silently in the background    Screenshot button to save and share your current progress    Local weather shown right on your desktop    One-time purchase, no microtransactions, ever    A homeless poodle who just wants somewhere to live

name: Topsoil
lang: English
short: Topsoil is a cozy desktop companion gardening game that turns the top edge of every window on your desktop into a living garden. Plant, tend and harvest while you work. Your browser becomes a tomato bed. Your code editor grows peas. Chat can look after the pumpkins for a while.
about: Your desktop is the garden  Topsoil is a cozy desktop companion gardening game that turns the top edge of every window on your desktop into a living garden. Plant, tend and harvest while you work. Your browser becomes a tomato bed. Your code editor grows peas. Chat can look after the pumpkins for a while.   Topsoil doesn't open a window. It grows on the ones you already have. Move a window and its garden comes with it. Make it wider and there is more room to plant. Everywhere outside the garden, your desktop works as normal.  Keep working, keep browsing, and pretend the corn is not getting taller during the meeting.          Plant a seed. Carry on.  Buy and plant seeds, water crops, spread fertilizer, clear weeds, spray bugs, and harvest when they are ready. Every crop grows differently. Some need more room. Some drink more water. Plant in season and the crop thrives. Plant against it and you will be working harder for the harvest.            Grow with the seasons  Spring, summer, autumn and winter roll through. The soil and grass change colour with them, and rain, snow and blown leaves drift across your screen.  Rain handles the watering for you. Hot weather leaves the soil thirsty. A hard freeze clears the weeds, and sends your crops, your frog and your goose to sleep along with them.  The forecast runs a week ahead. Prepare for a dry spell, hold out for rain, or plant anyway and deal with it later.          Employ a goose.   Your helpers take care of the repetitive work while you are away.  Scarecrows improve nearby crops. Frogs catch bugs. Sprinklers water the crops, beehives pollinate flowering crops while slowly filling with honey, and geese clears weeds and provides eggs for you to collect.   Leave a garden alone and the work continues without you.          Grow the operation  Improve how quickly crops grow, how much water they need, how well they resist pests, what they produce, and what the harvest is worth.        Your tools improve too. Reach farther, cover more ground, and turn a row of careful clicks into one satisfying sweep.       Choose your pace  Topsoil moves at the pace you choose.  Pick from four different modes and decide how quickly the garden changes while you work. Keep things slow and relaxed, or choose a faster rhythm that brings harvests, weather, and seasons around more often.  The garden will not wait forever, but you decide how much attention it asks for.       Made for the desktop  Topsoil is there when you want it and stays out of the way when you do not.  Tend a garden for a few seconds, then return to whatever you were doing. Crops keep growing, weather keeps changing, and helpers keep working while your attention is elsewhere.  Come back later to find crops ready to harvest, honey waiting in a hive, or the goose still busy with the weeds.

short: A pixel-art animal ranch that lives along the bottom of your desktop. Every keystroke and click you make while working drops coins for your animals to collect. Hatch eggs, collect and fuse 48 species, unlock six habitats, and watch them nap when you step away.
about: Work as usual. The ranch takes care of itself. animalbar is a transparent overlay that lives along the bottom edge of your screen, right above the dock or taskbar. It never asks for your attention. While you type, code, write or browse, every keystroke and click drops a coin, and your animals walk over to pick it up. Spend what they gather on eggs, new habitats and upgrades, and the ranch keeps growing while you get your work done. Features    Play while you work  – Keyboard and mouse input is the only resource. There are no separate controls to learn.    48 animals to collect  – Hatch eggs, fill the collection book, and fuse nine animals of the same grade into one of the next grade. Five grades, from Normal to Legendary.    7 skills  – Every animal has one skill that fires when its mana is full: coin magnet, haste, lucky charm, double drop, expedition luck, combo boost and mana aura.    6 habitats  – Forest, Ocean, Meadow, Jungle, Fantasy and Hell. Each habitat unlocks its own animals and its own coin skin, and animals that match the habitat gather twice as much.    Expeditions  – Send animals away on a trip and collect the rewards. The legendary Dragon and Phoenix are found only on expeditions.    Combo and Fever  – Keep the input flowing to build a combo. Every 500 combo starts a fever show that rains coins across the screen.    Naps  – Step away and the animals curl up and fall asleep. They wake up when you come back.    And more  – Placement presets, a wandering merchant, a lottery and a collection book, all inside a little book in the corner of the screen.   Made to stay out of the way   Choose the layer: everything behind your windows, only the animals in front, or the whole ranch in front.   Scale the game from 70% to 150%, pick the monitor it lives on, and start it with your computer.   Original background music and sound effects, muted by default so your meeting stays quiet.   Korean and English interface, switchable at any time.   Privacy animalbar only counts keystrokes and clicks. It never records which keys you press and never sends your input anywhere. Apart from Steam features, the only thing the game sends online is the feedback you choose to submit from the in-game button. On macOS the game asks for the Input Monitoring permission for this reason.

Build your own layout Choose weapons and support facilities, rotate their shapes, and fit them onto your construction board. Adjust their aim and make the most of limited space. Break through waves and bosses Fight enemies on the ground and in the air as you advance through each area's waves and boss encounter.
