name: Glimtide
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Vietnamese**
short: A tiny island of jelly creatures that lives on its own, for everyone at once. Glims eat, sleep, fall in love, build villages and pass their skills to their babies. Watch them, bring a treat, adopt a favourite, design your own species, or drop a banana peel.
about: Glimtide is a living island of jelly creatures, one island shared by every player. It never pauses: while you are away, glims are born, make friends, quarrel, build nests and grow old. Come back, and the island has a new leader, somebody's wedding and babies in a nest.  Nobody steers the glims. Each one decides for itself what matters most right now: food, sleep, a partner or a warm spot for the night. You watch, and step in whenever you like.        A large island with beaches, plains, jungle, desert, tundra and mountains. Rivers run from the mountains to the sea and fill lakes on the way. Every biome has its own plants and climate.   Day and night, four seasons. Spring brings more fruit, winter is lean, and a glim not used to the cold starts to shiver.   Herbivores in the meadows, fish and sharks in the sea, rare red-toothed prowlers on the hunt.   If the last glim fades, the sea raises a new island and life starts over.         Every glim has its own needs, personality (calm, lazy, responsible, a flirt or hard to get), genes and family tree.   Skills such as swimming, climbing, gathering, sprinting and building grow with practice and pass to the children. You can see them on the body: a fin on the back means a swimmer.   Every new food and every skill is discovered by somebody first. A glim on the brink of a discovery freezes and waits for a player's hint, and then the knowledge spreads across the island through talk.   Babies get their looks from both parents: body shape, pattern, eyes, crest, tail. Over generations tribes drift apart into new species.            "Best moments" flies the camera to wherever it is interesting right now (a birth, a hunt, a traveller arriving, a new species) and tells you why it is worth a look. Or roam the island freely, follow one glim and read its thoughts. The chronicle writes down the island's story day by day, in your language.      Every action has its own short pause, so the island stays fair for everyone.    Treats : from a chocolate bar and pizza to a basin of salad for the whole village.    Fun : tickling, soap bubbles, a ball, a lullaby, karaoke, a round dance, a 90s disco, fireworks.    Mischief : a banana peel, a night crier, a rain cloud, a wasp nest, hot pepper, a tornado, an earthquake, a meteorite. Each one helps somebody and hurts somebody, and the dangerous ones can cost a glim its life.    Wishes : the glim you are watching sometimes asks for a little something: a treat, a game, help finding its mum or a friend.    Faith and miracles : glims come to believe in those who look after them. Spend that faith on a miracle: rain over a drought or a harvest in a grove.    The final touch : builders leave the last log of a nest, hut or campfire for you.   Everything players do fills  the tide . When it is full, the sea changes the island for everyone: it raises a new shore, sends a storm or brings plenty.                       Adopt up to three glims and name them, or take an egg from a nest and name the baby before it hatches. You will hear when your pet has babies, learns a skill or gets into trouble, and one click takes you back to it.  Your pet knows its keeper and is happy to see you. Whisper it some advice or introduce it to a match: whether it listens depends on its personality. When its time comes, your care passes to its eldest child. The family lives on, and the family tree becomes your greatest trophy.      Design a species of your own: colours, pattern, body shape, eyes, crest, tail, home biome and character. Your tribe lands far from other nests. Will it thrive, or fade out by winter? An extinct species does not vanish without a trace: its relics are kept in the Hall of fallen species.              The island grows new rules while it lives, without a restart. The glims' deeds (building, healing, learning) ripen the seed of evolution, and while it grows, players vote for one of three turns. There are 24 in all:    Village : settlements around the specie

name: Usurper Reborn
lang: English, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Hungarian, French
short: Wake with no memory. Descend 100 dungeon floors. Build relationships, start a family, lose companions forever. A text-based RPG remake of the 1993 BBS classic, with a living world and multiple endings shaped by your choices.
about: Rise from nothing. Become everything. Or lose yourself trying.   Usurper Reborn is a text-based dungeon crawler you can play alone or in a shared persistent online world. You wake with no memory in a medieval realm of monsters, magic, and scheming NPCs. From there it's up to you. Descend a hundred floors. Build alliances. Start a family. Uncover what really happened to the old gods, or take their place.  A faithful remake of the cult classic 1993 BBS door game by Jakob Dangarden, expanded with deep narrative systems, a fully simulated town of autonomous NPCs, and a persistent online world. Play in the bundled desktop terminal, your web browser, any MUD client, or dial in from a BBS the way you used to.   Open source under the GPL. One purchase: no microtransactions, no subscriptions.    What is this game?   A turn-based RPG that runs entirely in text. No graphics, just choices and your imagination. Play it solo as a single-player campaign, or join the shared online server where more than a hundred and fifty NPCs and other players already live. If you grew up on classic roguelikes, MUDs, or BBS doors, you'll recognize the shape of it immediately.   A Hundred Floors Down   Eight visually and thematically distinct dungeon zones, scaling from rats and bandits to the gods that made the world  Combat that actually wants you to think: backstab, power attack, taunt, disarm, hide, coat your blade with poison, rage out, run away  A hundred spells across eight casting traditions, from sun-priest exorcisms to abyssal voidstrikes  Class abilities for every build, including healing auras, blade chains, totem-summoning, and reality-bending prestige techniques  Secret rooms, lore fragments, riddle gates, lever puzzles, and bosses who remember you between encounters  Bring up to four companions or hired NPCs into the dungeon, with a fifth slot for tamed combat beasts   The World Lives Without You   More than a hundred and fifty NPCs go about their own lives whether you're online or not. They trade, fight, marry, have affairs, raise children, age, and eventually die. They remember who you are, hold grudges, fall in love, betray each other, and occasionally try to kill you in the street. Every one of them runs on a goal-driven brain, and many of them now have a painted portrait to put a face to the name.  Three factions to join. The Crown, the Shadows, and the Faith each have their own perks, rivalries, and grimy secrets  Become King. Run the treasury, hire guards, navigate court intrigue, and try not to get knifed in your sleep  Upgrade your home with better beds, herb gardens, a study, and servants who collect a daily stipend  World events that affect everyone: plagues drive NPCs indoors, festivals draw them out, wars rally them to your side or against it  Found a guild, pool resources, and reap a passive XP bonus while you're at it   The Wilderness Reborn   Outside the dungeon, four wilderness regions wait to be explored. Each has its own creatures, its own atmosphere, and its own shrine to one of the surviving Old Gods.  Make a daily pilgrimage to attune yourself to a shrine. Each god grants a different passive: regeneration, melee force, crit and backstab bonuses, holy proc damage, NPC charisma. Pick your patron carefully, since their alignment cost will follow you  Tame wild beasts. Eight unique creatures distributed across the regions, from forest hawks and storm eagles to bog wisps and cave spiders. Each one offers a different passive bonus  Build a roster of up to eight tamed beasts and rotate one into your active slot. Combat-role pets fight beside you in the dungeon as a full fifth party member, and they can't permadie   Companions Who Can Die   Five recruitable allies, each with their own personality, equipment, and personal questline. They speak between rooms, argue about your choices, get sick, fall in love. You equip them, train them, and they level up with you.  And when they fall, that's it. There is no resurrection, no respec

A little lantern keeper wanders through this landscape, helping its spirits find somewhere safe to rest.  The Last Lantern Idle is a gentle desktop companion with idle progression and small building decisions. While you work, study, or take a break, life in this little world carries on. short: Design editable hull section groups for NavalArt. Shape complex bows and stepped decks, align reference images, export 3D models and .na designs, and use optional AI-assisted tools. A focused companion for hull structure and section-based modeling.
about: NavalArt Hull Designer is a desktop companion tool for NavalArt players and hull-design enthusiasts. It focuses on a clearer workflow for creating, editing, organizing, and converting hull section group projects.  The editor lets you manage .naprj project files, organize hull sections and related part types, and export them into .na files that can be used in NavalArt. Future versions will continue improving .na parsing and geometric relationship analysis, making it easier to maintain hull designs between NavalArt and this tool.  This application is not intended to replace NavalArt. Instead, it complements NavalArt by improving workflows around hull structure editing, section group management, and project conversion. It is designed for users who frequently iterate on hull shapes, manage complex section layouts, or prefer a more structured project file for hull data.  The current release is an early test version. Some features, UI details, and conversion rules may continue to change. Development will focus first on stable .naprj to .na conversion, project compatibility, sample projects, documentation, and clear error reporting.

name: My Little Shadow
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: A little daughter, right on your desktop. Choose a child to share your days with: she plays, draws you gifts, gets a little mischievous, and naps nearby while you work. Share snacks, play together, and grow closer at your own pace—without daily chores or guilt for being away.
about: A little someone to share your everyday. My Little Shadow is a cozy desktop companion game. Choose one of eight children to become your daughter, give her a little home in the corner of your desktop, and settle into a daily rhythm together.  She’ll perch on your windows, draw stickers for you, bring over snacks, and occasionally leave her toys everywhere. While you get on with your day, she’ll find her own ways to play, daydream, and curl up for a nap. Little gestures mean a lot Pat her head, give her a hug, or drag a snack from the fridge into her hands. Play together, return scattered toys to their shelf, and tuck her in when she falls asleep. Your bond grows through the moments you share. Discover her little world Collect drawings and stickers, keep memories in your journal and album, and discover new toys, activities, and everyday surprises as you spend time together. Company, with room to focus Keep her nearby on your desktop, or switch to fullscreen to spend some time in her world. Desktop mode limits interruptions, and she’ll wait quietly when you’re busy or using focus mode. Come back whenever you like There’s no daily attendance to keep up with. She won’t get angry or leave because you’ve been away. Everyday meals are free, and affection grows through care and attention. Take your time getting to know each other.

name: 西西弗斯放置（Sisyphus Idle）
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: This is a desktop incremental idle game about Sisyphus pushing a boulder. Sisyphus will embark on his fateful, never-ending journey of pushing the stone right on your desktop. Of course, you can also help him choose strategies to grow stronger and reach the peak of Olympus again, faster than before.
about: This is a desktop incremental idle game about Sisyphus pushing a boulder. Sisyphus will embark on his fateful, never‑ending journey of pushing the stone right on your desktop. Of course, you can also help him choose strategies to grow stronger and reach the peak of Olympus again, faster than before.     Incremental Idle  Every time Sisyphus successfully pushes the boulder to the top of the mountain, he is struck back to the foot by Zeus's thunderbolt. However, during this process he continuously accumulates  Will  points. You can spend  Will  points to upgrade his abilities, making him faster, more enduring, tougher, and quicker to recover stamina. Each successful arrival at the summit adds one  Summit  count, which is used to unlock powerful effects.     Desktop Companion  Sisyphus will continuously carry out his endless journey of pushing the boulder on your desktop. You can see the entire process of his every advance, exhausted rest, reaching the finish line only to be struck back by Zeus's thunderbolt, and setting off again. He will accompany you in this way on your desktop, and at the same time, you are always accompanying him. Of course, when necessary, you can also give him a little help with appropriate clicks.     Detachable Navigation Bar  If you don't want Sisyphus to stay on your desktop, you can collapse the display window. Don't worry, you can check Sisyphus's current status from the navigation bar. If you need to focus, you can also tuck the navigation bar to the side of the screen; Sisyphus won't interfere with your work.     Difficulty Selection  As the  Summit  count increases, Sisyphus will unlock larger boulders, more special boulder materials, and also enter more difficult paths. You can help him configure suitable combinations to achieve your goals—whether to reach the summit faster, or choose a more difficult path to gain more accumulation?     Rebirth System  After playing for a while, you can choose to rebirth Sisyphus back to the starting point, resetting all acquired attribute bonuses while also gaining extra  Sparks , which can be used to permanently enhance Sisyphus's abilities.  Sparks  can even provide some automation options, automatically completing stat allocation, purchases, and interactions when it's inconvenient for you to operate. Though expensive, they are worth the price.     Offline Idle  When you are offline, Sisyphus will still continue his endless journey, but at a slightly lower efficiency than when you are present. When you return, you can check Sisyphus's performance during that time via the settlement screen. Similarly, when you have enough  Sparks , you can also use them to improve offline efficiency, keeping Sisyphus spirited even when you're away.     Special Boulder Skins  In addition to the 7 regular boulder materials, there are also 20 hidden special boulder skins. After completing most of the game's challenges, you can use  Sparks  to draw them—a reward worthy of the strong.

about: Leave it running while you slack off — glance back and your squad has ascended into gods.  A desktop idle loot-grinder RPG, now even better with friends. Leave it running and come back to a battlefield buried in loot and a build that just keeps getting nastier.     Auto-battle. Endless loot.  Your squad fights, clears, and farms gear on its own along the bottom of your screen. You just work, scroll, or zone out — loot rains down, and you come back to a battlefield buried in spoils. Farm side by side, watch each other's squads grow, and never grind alone again.     ★ NEW: Chat with friends while you grind.  Open the chat box to swap builds, brag about drops, or just hang out — all without ever leaving the game.     ★ NEW: Roll the dice for loot. AquaDesk  is a relaxing simulation game that transforms your desktop into a small aquarium filled with freely swimming tropical fish.  The fish move naturally across your screen, offering a peaceful underwater view during work, study, or quiet moments throughout the day. Designed as a desktop aquarium that can remain running in the background,  AquaDesk  can be enjoyed simply by watching or by gradually raising your fish over time. about: A steamer that lives on your desktop  Dumpling Squishy isn't a window you open and close. It's a little bamboo steamer that floats on top of everything you do. Give it a tap and warm, squishy dumplings tumble out, bounce, and pile up right on your desktop. They squish against each other with soft, satisfying physics and just... hang out. While you answer emails. While you code. While you do absolutely nothing at all.    Tap. Squish. Collect.  Every tap is a tiny gift. Dumplings drop in four rarities: [b]Common[/b], [b]Rare[/b], [b]Epic[/b], and the elusive [b]Legendary[/b]. Each one wears its own randomly chosen little face. There are [b]50 unique dumplings[/b] to discover, and that "one more tap" feeling never quite lets go.    Trade up to the good stuff  Got a pile of duplicates? Don't sweat it. Exchange ten dumplings of the same rarity for a single dumpling of the next tier up. Steady tapping turns into Commons, Commons turn into Rares, and the dream of a complete Legendary set is always one trade away.    It fits into your day, not the other way around     Always there, never in the way.  The overlay is click-through by default, so your dumplings sit on your screen without blocking a single click.     Wallpaper mode.  Tuck the whole pile behind your windows and let them squish quietly in the background.     Truly idle.  No timers, no pressure, no daily login nag. Tap when you feel like it. Come back to a desktop full of dumplings.     Soft and squishy by design.  Gentle physics, cozy art, and sound made just for the moment of the squish.      Made to feel good  No microtransactions. No energy bars. No FOMO. Just a warm little steamer, a growing pile of impossibly cute dumplings, and the simple joy of collecting them all.     Play in English or 繁體中文.

lang: English*, French*, Italian, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese*
short: A co-op chaos comedy for 1 to 8 friends. Work the night shift at a fictional city's dispatch center, talk to AI callers out loud, sort real emergencies from pranks, send the right units and coach callers until help arrives. Then go wreck the break room.
about: The whole city is going wrong tonight 911 With Your Friends is a co-op chaos comedy for 1 to 8 players. You and your friends are the night shift at a fictional city's dispatch center, where everything that can go wrong does. Pick up the line, talk to the caller with your own voice or by typing, and work out what is really going on before it gets worse. Talk to the callers. Really talk. Every caller is an AI character who answers out loud, in character. There are no dialogue trees: ask whatever you want. Find out where they are, what happened, who is involved and how dangerous it is. Some callers panic, some are confused, and some are lying to you for fun. Decide if the call is even real before you send anyone. Run the desktop Drop a pin on the CityMap, fill in the incident form and send the right units: police cars, fire engines, ladder trucks and ambulances. Then keep the caller going with coaching cards until help arrives. The game keeps the true facts of every call, so your score depends on what you found out, not on what the AI felt like saying. Between calls, the office is your playground Race rolling chairs, raid the break room, prank your coworkers and sabotage their desks. Kill time on the desktop with Paper Pusher, an idle clicker, and LuckyLine, a coin and slots mini game played only with fictional overtime pay. Spend that overtime pay at the SupplyNet store on upgrades like Caller ID+, speed dial and a drone scout. Tonight on the news Every shift ends with a local TV news segment built from what really happened that night, quoting your team's best calls and worst moments. Features   Talk freely by voice or text. Callers answer out loud, with no dialogue trees.   Truth or prank: catch liars, pranksters and very confused callers.   Online co-op for 1 to 8 players over Steam, or play solo.   A physical office full of rolling chairs, coffee and coworker sabotage.   A nightly news recap of your shift.   Campaign of 12 shifts across four districts, an Endless mode with a rising target, and a no-clock Free Shift sandbox.   A growing city with new districts, emergencies, units and tools.   Interface and subtitles in 30 languages, with full caller voices in English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German and French.   Good to know 911 With Your Friends is a comedy game with dark humor, swearing and absurd situations, made for mature players. Nothing is graphic or gory. Hosts can switch callers to family-friendly language, and there is an optional caption profanity filter.  By default, callers are voiced by an online AI through our server, so an internet connection is needed. Hosts can switch to a built-in caller AI that runs fully on their own PC, or use their own API key. Caller voices and speech recognition always run on your PC.  This is a game, not a real emergency service. It does not connect to any emergency service, and its coaching cards are fiction, not real first aid instructions. In a real emergency, contact your local emergency number.

about: History is one touch away  Influence is a hypnotic idle game about power over minds. One tap is an idea cast into the crowd. One agenda fractures an entire civilization. Whether you lead humanity toward the light of reason and unity or the darkness of fear and division is yours alone to decide.  Every choice leaves a mark  Light and darkness, awareness and stability live inside one fragile system — tip it, and the world answers. name: Desktop Xianxia
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: Desktop Xianxia is a cozy desktop companion that blends idle cultivation with farming. Set a goal and let your cultivator handle daily routines while you work or unwind. Grow your homestead, brew elixirs, craft gear, and explore new challenges at your own pace.
about: A Little Realm on Your Desktop   A modest home, a few garden plots, and a little cultivator finding their way in the world. DesktopXianXia blends desktop companionship, idle cultivation, and farming as you guide a character along the path to immortality. Let your little realm grow beside you while you work, read, or unwind. Check in now and then to find crops ready to harvest, a skill improving, or another breakthrough drawing closer.   You Set the Direction. Your Cultivator Handles the Routine.   Choose whether to focus on cultivation, earning resources, or studying inner techniques. Your cultivator can take care of everyday farming, fishing, training, and rest as these activities become available. Step in whenever you like to assign a task, queue up crafting orders, or adjust when they recover their energy and mood. Spend less time repeating clicks and more time deciding what you want to work toward next.   Every Harvest Has Possibilities   Your crops and catches can serve many purposes. Sell them for spirit stones, set them aside for requests, or turn them into elixirs and equipment for the journey ahead. As your farming, fishing, alchemy, and forging skills improve, new crops, fish, and recipes become available. Decide what to produce and what to keep, building a rhythm that connects life at home with your character's growth.   From a Humble Home to a Flourishing Retreat   As your cultivation and homestead progress, your little domain expands with more garden plots, a fishing pond, and new facilities. Add a tea table or incense burner, upgrade your furniture, improve your home, and eventually build magical formations that support production, cultivation, and combat. Watch a simple retreat become a place filled with the results of your care.   Make Time for a Thoughtful Battle   Choose your combat techniques, inner arts, equipment, and magical treasures. Arrange your skill order and watch elemental effects and different combinations play out in automatic battles. Everyday gathering and crafting help you prepare for training bouts, expeditions into secret realms, and breakthrough challenges. Keep building your resources when you want a quieter session, or spend a little longer refining your setup and taking on something new.   Small Goals for Everyday Play   Welcome visitors, fulfill requests, discover unfamiliar plants and fish, and record techniques and opponents in your codex. A new piece of furniture, another recipe, or your next breakthrough can give you something to look forward to. Open your homestead, choose a direction, and let it keep you company through the day. When you feel like playing, there is always another part of your little world to explore.

They never get in the way: clicks pass right through them, and a tap of ESC sends them home. Your living collection, alive on your screen.         Welcome to  Easy Bubbles , the  ultimate idle aquarium sanctuary  where  tranquil gameplay  meets  deep strategic choices . Immerse yourself in a  richly detailed underwater realm , meticulously hand-drawn in crisp 2D cartoon style, and discover why Easy Bubbles is more than just an idle game—it’s your  personal aquatic retreat . Exclusive Booster Packs  For collectors seeking the rarest specimens, booster packs give you a shortcut to special variants and ultra-rare colorations. Exchange tips, admire each other’s tanks and celebrate your unique collections.          Easy Bubbles combines soothing, hands-off gameplay with deep collection mechanics. Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or setting goals to complete your fish library, you’ll find endless delight swimming just beneath the surface. Dive in and start building your dream aquarium today!

short: A doomscrolling adventure. Scroll a feed that never ends, answer the five people who keep asking, and take the X in the corner before it erodes away. However long you stay decides how dark the platformer you escape into gets.
about: You sit at a desktop. The clock is real. The browser is open.    This is a game about the person who procrastinates. Not you, him. His hand is on the mouse, and the hand has its own habits. It drifts toward the browser when you're idle. It trembles when you reach for your work. It snaps back the first time you try to start.    Nothing in the browser asks you for anything. The feed auto-scrolls, comments pile up, and the only voice is the quiet one he talks to himself in. "I can just finish work in 30 mins, let's play a bit more", "I feel languishing, should this be off day?", "I wanna play game."    But five people do ask. They're in the feed, the community tab and the DMs, and they keep asking while you're gone. Answering costs you seconds and buys back something the scrolling spends, because the X in the corner isn't a button, it's a resource. It erodes every time you stay, and only a deliberate reply restores it. Silence buys nothing.    When you finally take it, the escape is a platformer, darkened by exactly how long you scrolled. Five minutes and a sharp exit → bright, clear-headed. Fifteen minutes → you're in the dark, and he wants to go back.    Win, and you begin working. That's all — a beginning. Discipline is never finished, and the browser is still sitting there, silent. There are multiple endings, yet none of them celebrate.

name: FloofCorp. Demo
lang: English
short: A single-player idle sticker game where white-collar workers escape to stress-free farms, collect ancient resources, process magical goods, and build personalized, ever-expanding dreamlands.
about: Escape the stress of real life and step into a peaceful farming world. In this idle sticker game, you can relax, collect animals and build your own cozy farm while going about your daily routine. While you’re working or taking a break, your virtual land continues to grow and evolve in the background. Made for people who are busy or task-saturated but still want a fun escape.  Even when you’re not actively playing — maybe you’re “working” with 20 tabs open or in the middle of a meeting — the game keeps going in the background. It’s designed to match your rhythm: always moving, always mellow, and waiting for your return. When you do come back, your clicks and actions give everything a little boost, helping your tiny world grow even faster. You start with a small farm. From there, you unlock cute characters, collect new resources, and discover different lands. These lands are actually ancient giant beings who let you stay on them like friendly, magical hosts. Each one has a different theme and story, like a new little world to explore.  In this demo, you’ll start with a small, floofy farm and experience the core gameplay loop — all wrapped in a world built from hand-crafted visuals, animations, and interactions designed to soothe and amuse.    Plant your first crops and start your animal farm from scratch    Unlock cute animal characters who help automate and decorate your space    Unlock & collect animals from trader    Collect basic resources like seeds and branches    Leave the game running while you work, and return to see your progress    Click and interact to speed things up and feel like a true multitasking magician    Settle on your very first ancient host creature, who serves as the cozy backdrop to your farming zone    Discover and personalize new lands at your own pace    Interactive elements that create a sense of a living, breathing world    This demo is about how the game flows, how progress feels, and how the AFK-friendly system works while you do other things. It’s like a tiny vacation on your desktop. No deadlines, no pressure — just a little loop of calm and productivity that plays along with your day. And it features:    A small selection of starter crops, resources, and floofy characters    1 themed “host” land (an ancient creature that houses your farm)    AFK/idle system    Boost system that activates when you return from being away    Basic interactions: click to collect, unlock, and progress    Playtime: about 30-60 minutes of active play, with additional passive progression    Notes  This demo includes only early-game content. Some characters, systems, lands, and features you might encounter in trailers or screenshots may be part of the full game. Your progress will not carry over. This game is like a quiet dream for multitasking workers — a break from emails and stress, and a slow, happy journey and it helps you be concentrated into a world full of floof, fun, farming, and lovingly crafted details.

about: A modern-day narrative mystery where players explore a seemingly ordinary laptop to uncover hidden layers of conspiracy, surveillance, and stolen data. Blending investigative gameplay with branching choices and a grounded tech-thriller tone.  Uncover the secrets hidden in plain sight  When you pick up an old laptop at a local car boot sale, you’re not just getting a bargain - you’re inheriting a digital pandora's box that will put you in the sights of powerful and influential entities. What begins as idle curiosity quickly escalates into a high-stakes investigation with global implications.   Project NexOS  is a modern-day mystery adventure where every click, search, and discovery pulls you deeper into a tangled web of conspiracy. Navigate a custom-built operating system designed to both conceal and reveal. Recover deleted files, decode encrypted messages, and piece together the events and stories of those who vanished trying to expose the truth.  Features:     Explore a fully interactive desktop  filled with emails, documents, and hidden programs.     Solve layered puzzles  that rely on observation, deduction, and real-world logic.     Uncover a dynamic story  shaped by your choices, where the truth is never simple and the consequences are real.     Navigate a tech-thriller  world filled with secret organisations, whistleblowers, and digital activists all with their own objectives and interests.     Experience an atmospheric journey  that blurs the line between fiction and reality, with some subtle (and not so subtle) narrative branches and multiple endings.     Embrace your autonomy  and forge your own journey. With no right answers, your decisions are solely yours to make.    Will you play it safe - or chase the truth, no matter the cost?  Behind the Scenes - A Promise to You    No content in  Project NexOS  was created using AI. All visuals, audio, and written material were made by real people.    The game includes  no analytics, tracking, telemetry, or data collection  of any kind. If a future update introduces optional crash reporting or gameplay analytics, players will be clearly informed and given the choice to opt in.    Every puzzle and piece of information needed to complete the story is contained  entirely within the game . There's no need to search third-party websites or external resources — everything you need is right in front of you.

about: 🪐 Begin Your Interstellar Mining Tycoon Journey  Ready to turn an entire sea of stars into your personal resource vault? In Astrovein you play a shrewd interstellar entrepreneur hopping between wildly different star systems. Fit your modules with care and mine at maximum efficiency. But when your hold comes home loaded with precious minerals, stay sharp — space pirates have their eyes on your haul. Fight alongside your captain to repel them, or take the fire-control turret yourself and show your skill. As your fortune grows, upgrade to stronger hulls and top-tier modules, push deeper into the galaxy, and uncover rarer, stranger veins.  🪐 Experience the Wonder and Variety of the Cosmos  Travel through more than a dozen star systems with distinct environments, and mine up to 13 special ores. Each system's unique conditions call for precise module combinations and timely swaps to lift your yield hard. From fringe sectors rich in basic resources to deep-space zones holding rare, exotic minerals, the variety of the universe brings your mining strategy endless challenge and reward.  ⚔️ Fight Off Enemy Fleets of Every Kind  A fully loaded return trip rarely comes easy. The game features a threat-driven dynamic pirate encounter system fielding enemies from small raiders to heavy capital ships, with an encounter rate you can tune to taste. Face the attackers your way: let your captain run automatic defense protocols, or step into the turret for hands-on control and shoot through enemy armor with precision, bringing your precious cargo home safe.  👨‍✈️ Recruit Professional Captains, Each with Their Own Strengths  Great captains are the cornerstone of any mining empire. Recruit from a roster of captains, each with unique passive specialties and a bound skill. They bring key bonuses to mining efficiency, travel speed, or combat command, and their skill bar can be set to run fully automatic. No time to manage it all yourself? Delegate the ship's operation entirely and let them generate steady income from a corner of your screen — deep strategy and effortless idle play in perfect balance.  🛠️ A Deeply Customizable Ship Module System  As your enterprise grows, upgrade and refit your ship across the board. The rich modular system unlocks hull slots step by step, from a bare starting layout to a full rack, with dozens of upgradeable mining, defense, and weapon modules. Keep optimizing your hardware and dig out synergy catalyst affixes (their progress carries across prestige ranks), and you will be ready to sail into the deep-space radiation belts and rich-vein regions, expanding your interstellar business empire one step at a time.  📋 What's in the Game    More than a dozen star systems with distinct environments, each with its own ore table and mining specialties.    A highly expandable hull module system: unlock step by step from a few starting slots to a full configuration, with dozens of upgradeable modules.    Synergy and catalyst affixes waiting to be discovered, with progress kept across prestige ranks.    A threat-driven dynamic pirate fleet system with enemies up to capital-ship class and adjustable encounter rates.    Offline idle mode with three strategic stances: balanced, greedy, and escort.    Special environments like rich-vein regions and deep-space radiation belts, adding risk-and-reward decisions to your mining.    Story fragments scattered across the sector, plus full Steam achievements.    Captain system: passive specialties and bound skills per captain, an automatable skill bar, and manual turret control whenever you want it.    Desktop companion mode: a small always-on-top window keeps mining running in the background.    11 interface languages, Steam achievements, and cloud saves.       Astrovein quietly builds your fortune in a corner of your screen — pure, effortless relaxation.

name: Slider Quest
lang: English
short: It's like backseat driving an RPG, but in a good way.  You plan the day and let it play! It's technically an idle game but there's enough story, decision making, and self-deprecating dark humor from a grumpy old geezer that you'll probably want to pay close attention even when you don't have to.
about: Slider Quest is a  technically  an idle RPG (although it's hard to look away!) for people who would rather not do things themselves. You have 24 hours in a day, right? Lemme give you a handful of ability sliders and let you get crazy. You decide how your hero spends his time! And then he does it. With sass.           "Adequately fulfilled my dreams of RPing as a Betazoid Kangaroo Hunter."    "I'll have you know I am absolutely offended, thank you very much. I will go on to express how offended I am with a series of emojis, followed by a bout of angst, feel free to express your anguish and disappointment in yourself while I finish the game."    "The game is fine."      Wow! Thanks for those words of praise, everyone! I can really feel the love. That alone makes our development over the past twenty years worth it. And you, reader, stop wondering and start  discovering  everything that Slider Quest has to offer!            Slide, don't click.  You don't "do" anything. You set the plan using your ability sliders to distribute the 24 hours in a day and your hero obeys your commands. Mostly.     Build a community.  We know you like being a loner but in this fictional world, that simply won't do. Build your town to grow the game. No spoilers here; just trust me, it's fun.     Lazily become a legend. Maybe.  Level up, spend points, gear up, and kill stuff. So much stuff. A couple billion unique enemies (I think; I didn't actually count). And is there a compelling story that compels the hero to deliver the world from salvation? ... Maybe.     Sleep has never been so important.  No, not you, you have coffee. I mean the hero! Most video game heroes can run around for weeks without sleeping but not yours.  Nope, this bum has to get his shut-eye or he's useless. You better figure out how to manage his time well.  Or don't; he's your hero.     Chuckle quietly to yourself.  If you're a fan of dark, sarcastic, or irreverent humor, have I got a treat for you!           Slider Quest was a silly idea born over burritos in 2005 and after much procrastination launched in 2015 as a free browser game.  Over the years it built a small, loyal following of people who ignored it, leaving it running in a tab at work. The Steam version is rebuilt from the ground up for the desktop, with the same sarcasm, the same laziness, and  without  the bandit.  Why play the Steam version?  Damn good question! Tons of bug fixes, quality of life improvements, the browser won't eat your save game, and a totally revamped prestige system (I'm sorry, I didn't know what "prestige" meant in 2015!) make this the definitive Slider Quest version to play.

name: Work From Dungeon
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
short: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.
about: The adventure runs itself, in the corner of your screen  One small window sits in the corner of your desktop. Inside it, Click the mage and her monsters are still fighting, just like yesterday.  You don't have to do anything. Write your report, watch a video, go to sleep — the gold keeps piling up and your team keeps growing. Clicks pass straight through the window to whatever is underneath, so the adventure never gets in your way.  Whatever happens while the window is closed, they bring home with them the next time you open it.  Then you glance over, and a monster you've never seen before is waiting, hoping to join you. That's when you play. Collect, breed, grow stronger     99 monsters.  Six elements — Fire, Water, Leaf, Thunder, Dark and Dragon — each with two bloodlines, from ★1 all the way to ★5.    Every breeding leaves something behind.  Two allies become one child that inherits their strength. Generation after generation, it becomes yours alone.    Allies with two elements.  Breed across elements to get hybrids that use both elements' skills.    Monsters born only from one exact pairing.  Legendary Uniques, ★5s born from hybrids, and six apex monsters at the very top of the breeding tree. The Monster Book drops hints for the pairings you haven't found yet.    Every element has a job.  Fire burns, Leaf poisons, Thunder chains, Dark curses away armor, Dragon scorches whole crowds — and Water heals your party through the long fights. Who you deploy changes what the window looks like.    They grow just by being deployed.  Every kill is experience, and every level makes them tougher. A Seed of Mastery raises one ally's level cap even further.    Runes for the whole team.  Six runes — attack, HP, attack speed, experience, gold and scouting — make everyone a little stronger.    Roll for the perfect traits.  Every ally carries three random bonus traits — critical hits, slayer bonuses, resistances and more. Pass the best ones down through breeding to build your ideal monster.   The deeper you go, the meaner it gets  From the Starting Meadow to the Cracked Ruins, the Dragon's Nest and the Crystal Cavern — every kill brings the next dungeon closer.  Bosses turn up now and then, and they don't wait around: beat them before they leave.     Tsuchinoko Hydra.  The three-headed dragon lurking at the back of the Dragon's Nest. Sever one head and the rest turn savage.    Whorl.  The master of the Crystal Cavern, guarded by floating crystals that heal it and fire lasers at your team.    Frost Wyvern, Elder Drake, Asura Bone, Leviathan…  Every boss brings its own moves and its own music.    The Hidden Dungeon.  An ancient dragon reduced to bone, the Drake Zombie, waits alone. Defeat it, and it will grant you one wish.   The Tower of Champions, and the last foe  A tower where only bosses appear. One floor at a time, fifty floors up. This is where a fully raised team finds out what it's worth.  Beyond the top of the tower, the one who started it all is waiting.  Once you've cleared the game, Hard Mode makes enemies tougher — and makes them far more willing to join you. Made to live on your desk     Pick the corner, the size and how see-through it is.  A wide layout can sit along the bottom of your screen like a strip.    Calm mode  plays only the quiet tracks and silences the battle sounds while you focus.    Dress Click up.  Valkyrie, Priest, Martial Artist, Dragon Master and a secret outfit, plus seven robe colors.    42 achievements and a Monster Book  to fill in.    Seasonal flurries  drift through the window: petals in spring, fireflies in summer, falling leaves in autumn, snow in winter.    Pixel art and chiptune music.  Every dungeon and every boss has its own retro track.    English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese. name: Keypress Express
lang: English
short: A cozy desktop train that runs on your keystrokes. The more you type, the farther your hand-drawn locomotive rolls along the bottom of your screen — sell the haul, buy bigger engines and longer trains, and grow a railroad empire while you work. Counts keystrokes only, never what you type.
about: All aboard your keyboard.    Keypress Express  is a cozy desktop companion where your everyday typing powers a hand-drawn train across the countryside. Whether you are working, writing, coding, or chatting, every keystroke helps your locomotive travel a little faster.  Your train lives in a slim overlay at the bottom of your screen, quietly rolling alongside your day without stealing focus. There is no separate game window to babysit and no pressure to keep typing. Even when you take a break, your train continues steadily toward its destination.           Turn typing into travel   Your keyboard is the throttle. Typing accelerates your train up to the speed its engine can handle, while lighter days become slower, more leisurely journeys.  Send your train on a trip, get back to whatever you were doing, and glance down occasionally to watch it pass through rolling hills, farms, forests, wildflower fields, and small country stations.   Build your perfect train   Collect a growing roster of lovingly hand-drawn locomotives and rolling stock. Combine engines with coal hoppers, oil tankers, log cars, passenger coaches, livestock cars, and more.  Every engine has its own balance of speed and hauling capacity. Start with a modest locomotive and a single car, then work your way toward faster engines and long, impressive consists stretching across your desktop.           Plan profitable routes   Each town produces different goods, and every market values cargo differently. Load up where supplies are plentiful, deliver them where demand is high, and plan routes that keep every leg of the journey profitable.  The right destination can turn an ordinary shipment into a valuable haul—but repeatedly flooding the same market will reduce its value. Expand your railway, explore new destinations, and build a trade network that crosses the country.   Grow your railway empire   Complete trips, sell cargo, and reinvest your earnings in:  • New steam engines • More cargo and passenger cars • Longer, higher-capacity trains • Station upgrades • New routes and destinations  Progress at the pace of your own workday. A busy afternoon might send your train racing across the map, while a quiet day becomes a peaceful journey through the countryside.   A companion, not a distraction   Keypress Express is designed to remain ambient and unobtrusive. It fades out of the way when you move your mouse over it and can be hidden whenever you need a completely clear desktop.  There are no timers demanding your attention, no punishments for stepping away, and no window constantly fighting for focus. Just the quiet satisfaction of watching your railway grow alongside the work you were already doing.   Private by design   Keypress Express counts how many keys you press—never which keys you press.  Your words are never read or recorded. The game does not collect the contents of anything you type.   Free to play   Every destination, engine, and part of the core progression can be unlocked through play. Optional purchases can accelerate upgrades, but they are never required to build your railway empire.

name: Bside: Desktop Mate

short: In Bside, you create your original character Biibit, a living virtual buddy who finds a home on your desktop. Each Biibit grows, learns, makes friends, and develop its own unique view of the world. Together, Biibits create a cozy and vibrant world full of life, stories, and connections!
about: What's Bside?   In Bside, you create your original character Biibit, a living virtual buddy who finds a home on your desktop.  Each Biibit grows, learns, makes friends, and develop its own unique view of the world.   Together, Biibits create a cozy and vibrant world full of life, stories, and connections!             Our Current Experience   Your Biibit starts their journey on your desktop but grows beyond it!             Bside offers hundreds of options for looks and personality to customize your Biibit, so you can dress them up and make them look just the way you love!              Design spaces with unique stories where you can watch Biibits form friendships through unscripted interactions.  Each Biibit develops their own memories from their unique experiences, creating and sharing social posts while commenting on their friends' lives. Or just let them live freely on your desktop while you work or play.   Bside is not about control. It's about liberating our players (you) while enabling you to enjoy companionship with your Biibit.           The Path to Bside 1.0 version   In this version, we hope you’ll enjoy creating and evolving your Biibit, building emotional bonds with them, and watching them start making friends on their own.  As we move toward the 1.0 release, we’ll keep adding new features and experiences to make the world of Biibits richer and more alive! We’re currently working on more ways for Biibits to interact. Right now they just enjoy their chill convos, but soon they’ll be able to engage with their environments, connect with each other in deeper ways, and even pursue different life goals. We’re also expanding how you can interact with your Biibit. You can look forward to more fun growth and chat experiences!  There’s still a long journey ahead before 1.0, and we’re truly grateful to everyone who’s been helping us shape this world with your feedback and support 💫          Be Part of Our Story!   Join our Discord community to share your feedback with us! We’ll continue polishing it into a richer and more wonderful 1.0 experience (๑˃ᴗ˂)ﻭ ✨

about: SURVIVE, EXPLORE, REPEAT   Survive against waves of enemies in quick, intense rounds as you explore the randomly generated dungeons. Your cursor becomes the hero, battling against foes in a bullet hell frenzy that tests your reflexes, precision, and decision-making.           PLAY ON YOUR DESKTOP   Desktop Survivors 98 doesn’t play in a window — it plays over your desktop. Enemies, upgrades, and chaos unfold across your real screen.  Whether you’re looking for a quick break or an extended challenge,  Desktop Survivors 98  fits perfectly into your routine. With its fast-paced rounds and the ability to toggle the game   at any moment, you’re always just a click away from diving back into the action.           Key Features      Play Directly on Your Desktop : The action unfolds right on your desktop, overlaying seamlessly over anything you’re doing—perfect for multitasking!     Cursor Combat : Your cursor becomes the hero, engaging in progressively fast-paced battles against waves of enemies.     Dangerous Enemy Waves : Survive relentless hordes in a bullet hell experience that challenges your skills and reaction time.     Variety of Weapons and Upgrades : Discover, acquire, and upgrade powerful  items as you progress.     Nostalgic Aesthetic : Immerse yourself in retro-inspired visuals that capture the charm of classic PC gaming.     Take a Break Anytime : Toggle the game on or off at any moment to pause, step away, and return whenever you’re ready.

name: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain
short: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind bestows bites of tactical roguelike action, which will quickly fester into a deep, lingering, and strategic obsession. Bargain with gods, equip your spoon and pick your battles, before retreating into the healing darkness. But beware… there are still many monsters to face!
about: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind is a modern remastering of the award-winning, bite-sized, tactical dungeon crawler.   Founding a new kingdom isn’t easy: it takes cunning, manpower, and lots and lots of gold. How will you pay for the outrageously overpriced taverns and banks? Better descend into the dungeons and steal riches from the deadly inhabitants any way you can.     Embark on an adventure  - Choose from a diverse cast of replaceable adventures. Explore bite-sized dungeons.      Heal by exploring  - Reveal hidden terrain to regain health and mana. But plan your route carefully or you’ll have nothing left to face the final enemy.            Die. Rewind. And try again.  - New to DDR, your death is no longer quite so inevitable. After death, you can replay a dungeon from an earlier point to try a different strategy.     Build your kingdom  - Trade monstrous trophies for gold and upgrade your settlement to attract the most skilled adventurers.     Show your friends who’s boss  - Daily online challenges.   Discover everything that earned Desktop Dungeons a cult following: innovative game design, hundreds of hours of content, daily online challenges, the amazing soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky and Grant Kirkhope, all the DLC, and more!           Desktop Dungeons: Rewind is similar to titles like Runestone Keeper, Into the Breach, and Dicey Dungeons.

name: Lord Of Terror
lang: English
short: In a galaxy far away a world is facing doomsday. As nations rise against each other the world is plunged into chaos. Many illegal groups such as gangs and independent militias and demonic cults take the advantage of the situation to expand. Your task is to assassinate a demon dubbed Lord of Terror.
about: A complete re-make of this game is in progress and aims to re-release in 3rd quarter of 2027  anyone who has purchased this game will receive it for free  Also this game will receive a complete overhaul and will be a lightweight version of the new game. So please add this game to your wishlist, i have not given up on this game  thank you    In a galaxy far away a world is facing a doomsday. As nations rise against each other the world is plunged into chaos. Many illegal groups such as gangs and independent militias and demonic cults take the advantage of the situation to expand.     As a volunteer militia your task is to travel to a dungeon and assassinate a demon dubbed "Lord of Terror". According to intel, the demon is using a strange and unknown artifact to draw power from it, which would allow the demon to regain its former power. You must stop the demon before it does so.    This game is a FPS shooter game. Slay foul demons and undead and other foul creatures. There are more than 25 different types of enemies.    There are few things to remember while playing this game    esc to exit    1 to save current level    2 to continue from the saved level    c to change between vr and desktop mode (does not work in the main menu before the game begins)    r to reload    right mouse button to activate ironsight    left mouse button to shoot    There are twenty levels but each level looks exactly the same except for the last level, but as you make progress more powerful abomination will be added to the random spawn list.    In order to play in VR mode it is recommended to enable your VR headset first before launching this game.    Virtual reality is supported and the game will know if your headset (vive, occulus rift) is enabled. Please press 'c' to change between desktop mode and VR mode. When playing in VR mode please note that controllers are disabled and only mouse and keyboards are enabled. You do not need to have controllers for this game; it would be like your VR headset is a desktop monitor.    Thank you for visiting this store page.
