name: Treefiner
lang: English
short: Treefiner is a short chillmulation game. Use your mouse to purge popups and collect currency. Buy upgrades to get deeper in the loop and refine your skill tree to crack the game.
about: There's a desktop shortcut labeled "start"... you click it and a popup appears. Let the loop begin.  Features     Relaxing gameplay:  loot currency to farm, buy upgrades to get stronger     Fast-paced progression:  unlock new upgrades every minute     Theory-crafting:  optimize your upgrade tree to clear the bosses     Low stakes:  reset your upgrades at any time if you're stuck                There are 125 unique upgrades to unlock. Experiment with different builds and find the right combination to clear the game!

name: My Mysterious Creature
lang: English
short: A curious little creature comes to live on your desktop. It potters about while you work, quietly settles down when you're busy, naps when you're away, and grows closer to you over days. It speaks no words, only feelings. Raise it, dress it up and just enjoy the Mysterious creature.
about: A mysterious little creature that lives on your desktop and quietly keeps you company. It isn't really a tool, though it does have a few handy tricks. Most of all, it's here to make you smile on the hard days.  Its little toolbox  Double-click it any time and a small toolbox opens up. No setup, no account:  - A focus timer it cheers you through, and celebrates when you finish  - One-click screenshots, or a multi-photo mode, saved straight to your desktop  - Quick sticky notes for a stray thought  - Gentle eye-care reminders, so you look up from the screen now and then  - A Do Not Disturb switch for when you just want quiet                                                                                                             Company first, handy desktop buddy second.    A little life of its own  It wanders, potters, and plays. Chases a ball, doodles, stretches, naps, and stargazes at night. It explores across your monitors on its little adventures.  Speaks no words, only feeling  It comes from somewhere else and doesn't use language. Everything it thinks or feels comes out as little wordless symbols.  Make it yours  Choose its color, dress it in dozens of accessories, take its portrait. No shop, no loot boxes, no pay-to-unlock, ever. Everything is earned with time and care.  Music and little moments  A small dance party. Karaoke where you bring your own lyrics and sing while it mouths along. And on holidays, friendly visitors drop by with seasonal surprises.  Give it a voice, if you'd like (optional)  Connect a free AI that runs right on your own computer (like Ollama or LM Studio) and it can talk with you, and help with little things when you ask, like checking the weather or tidying up text you've copied. Anything that touches your clipboard or screen is opt-in only, with a clear notice every time. No accounts, no subscriptions, nothing to sign up for and the creature is perfectly happy without it.  Private by design  The creature runs entirely on your own computer. It pays attention only to broad signals, like the kind of app you're in and the time of day, never your files, your messages, or what you type.  Creature-to-creature visits (experimental)  A friend on the same network can visit, swap an outfit, or trade a paper-airplane note. Local network only for now.  Wishlist now. My Mysterious Creature arrives on Steam soon.

name: Palnion
lang: English
short: Meet Palnion, your interactive desktop buddy! He walks freely on your screen, plays mini-games with you, and helps you remind things like drinking water. Indecisive? Let him choose for you! With Steam Workshop, you could have everything you've ever imagined.
about: Ever felt like your desktop is a bit too quiet? Too professional? Too... boring?   Meet  Palnion , the ultimate virtual companion that turns your screen into a lively, interactive playground! He walks freely across your windows, and brings a whole new vibe to your daily PC use. Need a 2-minute break from coding, studying, or working? Palnion is always ready to play with you!    Palnion isn’t just here to look cute and distract you, he actually has your back!   He’ll gently remind you thing like standing up before you turn into a  human pretzel .  Can't decide what to eat, what game to play, or which task to start? Put the choices in, and let your buddy make the executive decision for you!    Tired of the same old look? Thanks to full Steam Workshop support, you can completely change your experience. Download crazy, beautiful, or downright hilarious companions created by the community.    Palnion has an actual mood system. Keep him happy and entertained, or face the consequences! If his happiness drops too low, he might get a little chaotic, like  trying to hijack your mouse cursor!

name: Rebuild 3: Gangs of Deadsville
lang: English
short: Rebuild a ruined city in this post-apocalyptic mix of strategy and simulation. Manage survivors, scavenge for food and supplies, deal with rival gangs, illness, interpersonal strife and zombie attacks.
about: It's been a few years since the zombpocalypse turned the world's cities into graveyards and sent the few survivors into hiding. Now you must gather them up and restore civilization to a ruined city, one building at a time.   Rebuild 3  is a strategy sim with a good helping of narrative and dark humor. It'll make you fond of your survivors before you send them to their deaths for the greater good. As you expand your fort to new buildings, you'll decide between farms or fortifications, housing or hospitals, and make tough decisions to fend off raiders, illness, starvation, and madness. And the dead are still out there wandering the streets, hungrier than ever. Features     4X style strategy and city (re)building    Endless replayability with randomized cities and events    Survivors with individual skills, perks, relationships, and stories    Rival NPC forts with their own agendas, friendly or otherwise    Campaign Mode, a journey through cities of increasing size and difficulty    Strategic fort defense and interactive attacks    Play in either real-time or turn-based mode    5 skills: defense, leadership, scavenging, building, engineering    30 missions: scavenge for food, kill zombies, fish, trade, bartend, craft...    35 node research tree    50 building types with unique uses and/or scavengeable resources    200,000 words of event text - enough to fill two novels   Bonus features in the Deluxe Survivalist Edition     Desktop version of Rebuild 1 (previously only available in browsers)    Desktop version of Rebuild 2 (including "winter" mobile content)    5 bonus professions for your main leader    5 corresponding unique items    PDF artbook

name: Floating Farmer - Logic Puzzle
lang: English*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Spanish - Latin America*, Portuguese - Portugal**
short: Build a path for the mothers and their babies, and bring the farms back to land.
about: A country life, raising animals on a ranch. You’ve been living in this tiny fantasy countryside, a very relaxing environment, but suddenly something unusual happened. You wake up one day and all the animal farms are now floating like little islands in the sky! The paths were shuffled and the baby animals were spread.   To fix this, slide the blocks to rebuild the broken paths. So you help moms unite the families again and bring the farms back to land.            Click and drag a block in one direction and all moveable blocks in the row/column will slide one position in that direction;   A slightly Rubik's cube-like mechanics: a moveable block reaching one edge slips to the opposite edge;   To solve the logic puzzle, arrange the blocks to create a path for mom to gather all babies and reach home.   Rotate the camera to better see the blocks.   Remember: some blocks are fixed, they will not slide!   As you progress solving the logic puzzles, have the great feeling of uniting families and see your land farm expand.  There is no time limit or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on solving the puzzles while listening to a soothing soundtrack and animal sounds. NEW AUGMENTED REALITY EXPERIENCE WITH THE TILT FIVE™ SYSTEM!        Floating Farmer Supports Tilt Five  Level up your game night with tabletop holograms! The Tilt Five™ holographic gaming system transforms tabletop and video games into 3D vibrant holographic environments. Using the Tilt Five™ augmented reality (AR) glasses, Gameboard, and Wand controller, you can immerse yourself --  and friends  -- in experiences like never before. Visit Tilt Five's website to find out how to bring Floating Farmer alive on your tabletop!       Wearing the Tilt Five™  glasses, you'll feel like you're among the clouds, flying over a beautiful field of farms. The farm to be arranged will be at your fingertips, allowing you to explore every detail of the plants and animals, zooming and rotating the farm using the wand.  Use the tip of the wand to select and push the blocks in the desired direction to solve the puzzles.   See up close the joy of puppies finding their mothers and returning home!       To explore these optional features, a Tilt Five™ system is required (available for Windows OS).  The classic Floating Farmer desktop gameplay is still available for everyone (Windows and macOS).   The Tilt Five™ feature for Floating Farmer is intended as a seated experience. To learn more about Tilt Five™, visit their website

name: FloofCorp.
lang: English
short: A handcrafted idle sticker desktop animal farm game. Unlock & collect animals. Stress-free farms with white-collar workers. You can process magical goods, and build personalized, ever-expanding dreamlands for your animals.
about: This is a cozy desktop sticker game made for people who are busy but still want a fun escape to hand-crafted worlds with animals.   Maybe you're answering emails. Maybe you're in a meeting. Maybe you are filling sheets. Maybe you just forgot the game was open. That’s okay — it keeps going.  While you're doing your real-life stuff, your little world is still running in the background. And when you come back, you get to see all the progress you made. Tap a few things, collect your rewards, make a few upgrades, and you’re all set again. Then you can go back to whatever you were doing. It’s simple. It’s calming. It’s designed to fit into your day, not take it over.  You start with a tiny farm for your animals. Just a few crops, a chick, a chicken, a sheep and a peaceful vibe. As you play, you unlock and collect cute animal characters who keep things moving while you're away. You gather resources like wood and crops. You slowly upgrade your setup. And before you know it, you’re traveling to new lands.  But these lands aren’t just maps — they’re  giant ancient creatures  who let you live on their backs. Each one is different. One might be covered in moss and mushrooms. Another might be glowing with jellyfish lights. They all have their own personalities, and you can decorate them however you like. It’s like traveling through soft, sleepy dreamworlds — all designed to be comforting and fun.  Everything is hand-drawn and animated with care. The sounds are gentle. The loops are slow and satisfying. The characters are squishy and weird in the best way. It’s a game made to be enjoyed in small moments, in between the busy parts of your life.   What You’ll Do     Start your first cozy farm for your animals    Unlock and collect animal characters who help you farm, gather, and build    Collect resources to upgrade and decorate your world    Let the game run while you’re doing other things - animals could keep it going without you    Come back and give everything a little boost with your clicks    Travel to new magical lands hosted by ancient creatures    Customize and decorate each land your way    Discover small stories and surprises as you explore       What Makes It Special     No pressure. No timers yelling at you. Just progress at your pace.    Designed for multitaskers and people who like to check in and zone out.    Everything is hand-crafted — all the art, animations, and sound are made with care.    The creatures and characters are strange, soft, and oddly relatable.      Handcrafted by & made for multitasking workers who dream of a quiet animal farm with care.

name: Cindervale
lang: English, Russian
short: A voxel-based sandbox game focused on survival, building, and engineering. Start in a large city, mine ore, smelt metal, wire up electricity, and assemble functional machines—ranging from wind turbines to computer-controlled factories. Play solo or with friends.
about: Cindervale   is a first- and third-person voxel sandbox about survival, building and engineering. Start on the square of a big starter town, chop your first logs and work your way from a wooden pickaxe to your own industry. Ore becomes metal, metal becomes parts, and parts become machines you assemble yourself.               Every new world begins in a town of 181 × 181 metres: Peace Avenue, a square with an obelisk, a House of Culture with a cinema, a post office, a grocery, a pharmacy, a hotel, a canteen, a fire station, a school with a stadium, a park with a pond, a farm, a water tower, a sawmill, a machine yard and a wind farm. Power already runs down the streets, and the bank and the market have working computer terminals.  Settle in, set up a workshop — or head out beyond the last fence. A cosy homestead, an industrial complex, trading with your neighbours or travelling: the goal is yours to choose.            Smelting and alloys.  Furnaces, channels and casting moulds turn ore into steel, bronze and copper wire.     Mechanics.  Shafts, gears, gearboxes and governors carry the turn; conveyors and loaders move the goods.     Fluids.  Pipes, tanks, valves and pumps. A distill column splits crude oil into diesel, naphtha and lubricant.     Machine tools.  A sawmill, a power hammer, a lathe and a crusher make the parts for your next machines.    Every new machine is a reason to go back down the mine, grow the workshop and work out how to haul everything in.               Put up wind turbines, water wheels, steam turbines or solar panels. String wires across insulators and wire in batteries, switches and circuit breakers. Street lamps light up at dusk, while electric furnaces, pumps and machine tools take over the work.  And yes, there are  computers . The AlegorPX desktop holds documents, mail, chat, a network map, a bank and a market. The Power Grid and Factory programs show the load and let you run machines remotely, and Automation switches equipment on IF–THEN rules.       Grow wheat, potatoes, carrots, beets, onions, corn and cabbage — crops need water and healthy soil. Food spoils, so keep it in an electric refrigerator or can it. Hunt, beware of wolves and bears, and get a roof over your head before nightfall: a day lasts 40 minutes, and the weather turns from a clear morning to a thunderstorm.  Industry changes the land around it. Smoke, oil spills and waste pollute the air, the soil and the water. Fit chimney filters, clean the water and the ground — and keep the factory away from your fields.               Build a CV-46 freight truck for heavy loads, the Kestrel motorboat, the Survey hot-air balloon, a powered hang glider, a walking tractor or a diesel locomotive with freight wagons. Vehicles need fuel, maintenance and a planned route, and cargo changes how they handle.       Make your settler your own: 16 jackets, 8 pairs of trousers, 10 hairstyles, 8 skin tones, an ushanka, a cap, a hard hat or a beanie, build and height. Play in first person or switch to third person with F5.  Open your world to friends over the network or run a dedicated server. Build a shared settlement, split the work between the farm, the mine and the workshop, trade through the computer market and put up signs with your own words. Survival mode is for those who like it hard; Creative mode is for free building and experiments with machinery.               Nine original music tracks follow the place and the time of day: morning meadows, the workshop, the night, deep caves, the town square. More than 400 sounds, from footsteps on ten surfaces to the hum of machinery. Nine animal species with their own voices, twenty kinds of plants, grass and treetops swaying in the wind. Ore is scarce on the surface — you will have to go down into the deep caves for it.          Early Access  Cindervale is in active development and has already received several major updates during its open beta. Expect bugs, changing mechanics and lower performance on w

name: Heliodawn
lang: English**
short: You start with a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, and a farm. You end with rockets flying, colonies on the Moon and Mars, and cargo flowing between every world you've built. An idle incremental game about building humanity's space program from the ground up.
about: Day one: a coal mine, an iron mine, a well, a farm. That's it. Earth is modern but empty of space infrastructure, and the only way forward is to build it yourself.  Mine coal to make power. Smelt iron into steel. Refine oil into rocket fuel. Process air into oxygen and nitrogen. Grow the supply chain until you've got electronics, composites, and a rocket assembly plant. Then you launch.    Low orbit is a station, not a home — a staging point you use to reach the Moon. The Moon has polar ice and regolith and no atmosphere. Mars has thin air full of CO2 and enough water locked in the ground to run a Sabatier reactor and brew your own methane. Each world is a new economy you have to rebuild for the environment you're in.  Transport ties it all together. Ships run fixed loops between worlds — Earth to orbit to the Moon, Earth to Mars, Moon to Mars — hauling whatever cargo you tell them to haul. You pick the stops. You pick the cargo. You scale the fleet. A single screen shows every line in your network at a glance, green where it's flowing and red where it's stalled.    No lose state. Close the game for a week and your colonies are still there, making things, waiting.   Key Features   The gameplay is logistics, production, and network-building — not piloting or physics. The systems below are what ships today.     A production chain built on real recipes:  Rockets burn RP-1 kerosene refined from crude oil. Mars methane comes out of a Sabatier reactor fed by local CO2 and hydrogen split from water ice. Steel is iron ore cooked in a smelter. Nothing is magic. Everything is a recipe.     Four worlds, four economies:  Earth, low orbit, the Moon, and Mars. Each has its own buildings, its own resources, and its own production problems to solve. You don't pilot ships or manage orbits — you build the supply chain that keeps each world fed.     Transport is the game:  Ships run fixed loops between worlds. Pick the stops, pick the cargo, scale the fleet. Watch the whole network on a single screen and catch the one line that just stalled.     A tech tree you can follow:  Power Systems. Atmospheric Processing. Fuel Chemistry. Rocket Engineering. Orbital Operations. Lunar Exploration. Mars Transit. Every tech unlocks a building you can actually build.     Population that you have to keep alive:  Colonies need habitats, food, water, and oxygen. People are your workforce, and losing the supply chain that supports them doesn't kill them — it just stops everything from working. Managing that tension is half the game.     Offline progress that respects your time:  Close the tab. Close it for a week. The game keeps ticking. Come back to stockpiles and a running economy.       Ranks to chase:  Tiered achievements on every resource and building, feeding a 20-rank ladder from Ground Crew to Stellar Vanguard.       Built for long play:  Auto-save every 30 seconds. Export and import your save. An example save for exploring a mid-game state. Four theme presets plus full color customization. A curated soundtrack. A desktop client with a clean borderless window and updates that land without asking.

name: Nan-Bei Chao: War of Dynasties
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Strategy card game set in China's Northern and Southern Dynasties. Command nine historical rulers and 120 general, minister and stratagem cards across four battle lines - infantry, cavalry, navy and strategy - each scored alone. Every card costs provisions, and your hand carries over between rounds.
about: One game of North vs. South, half a history of China.  About the Game  From 420 to 589 AD, China split into Northern and Southern Dynasties — the South cycling through Song, Qi, Liang and Chen, the North through Northern Wei, Eastern Wei, Western Wei, Northern Qi and Northern Zhou. Nine legendary rulers contend for the Central Plain across 120 cards drawn from the annals: generals, ministers, poets, formations, monks, crafts, items and stratagems. Nan-Bei Chao: War of Dynasties is a strategy card game built on that turbulent era, turning historical figures, legendary campaigns and military doctrine into matches anyone can pick up. Every ruler carries a distinct faction identity (Song · Purple, Qi · Cyan, Liang · Gold, Chen · Green against Northern Wei · Red, Eastern Wei · Blue, Western Wei · Grey, Northern Qi · Orange, Northern Zhou · Dark Gold), and every general has his own ink-wash portrait — all card art is AI-assisted ink-brush warrior illustration, built on ochre, gamboge and ink black with faction-colored highlights.  Core Gameplay  Four Battle Lines  The battlefield splits into four rows, each scored independently:     Infantry  — sieges, close-quarters fighting     Cavalry  — raids, volleys, charges     Navy  — warships, the Yangtze, fire attacks     Strategy  — schemes, deployments, supply lines     Each row resolves on its own : higher row power takes the row.    Both sides have cards → compare row power    Only one side has cards →  conceding the row loses it     Both empty → draw, not counted     Taking more rows wins the round ; on an even split, total round power breaks the tie.  Eight Card Types     General  — the backbone, each with unique active and passive skills     Minister  — court officers who strengthen you or disrupt your rival     Poet  — commands by verse, chaos through literature     Monk  — turns calamity through Buddhist rites     Craft  — engineering, provisions and materiel     Formation  — troop commands like the Beifu Army and the Queyue Formation     Item  — chevaliers, fire oil and other oddities     Stratagem  — cards that bend the game: card draw, Dark Passage, Linked Stratagem, Counterintelligence    Provisions: Your Play Budget  Provisions are the core resource — every card costs provisions to play .    Both sides start with  20 provisions     From round two, each round adds  +8  automatically (the second player gets 1 extra)     Provisions carry over  — unspent supply rolls into the next round    Hand limit  20 cards     Running out of cards isn't a loss, but an empty treasury forces you to discard and pass — resource management is the real tension of every round .  Hands Carry Over  The single most important rule: the board resets each round, but your hand does not.     Units on the board — all withdraw at round end; the next round starts from an empty field     Your hand is kept  — whatever you didn't play last round is still in hand    From round two,  6 new cards  arrive each round (into hand, up to the 20-card limit)    So the real wager isn't "who's stronger in this row" — it's "which cards do I still have to survive three rounds" . Your opponent sees the you who brought old cards into round two. Holding cards, hoarding provisions, managing the cap — all of it is strategy.  Mulligan   Only the first round deals 10 cards and offers a mulligan — discard up to 3 cards and draw the same number back. Rounds two and three have no mulligan phase, only new cards.  Traps: The Hidden Edge   Trap cards hide in your hand and can be buried into any row:     Deer Antlers  — destroys the opponent's first Cavalry card     Fire Oil Burnt Bridge  — that row takes −4 power all round     Ambush  — triggers on any card played in the row     Iron Caltrops  — caps a row at 2 cards, stopping infinite burials    The rule is strict: only the player who buried them can see how many traps exist — the opponent gets no warning at all. When one triggers, the victim gets an on-screen alert.

name: Innkeeper's Basement
lang: English

Inspired by Slay the Spire, Runestone Keeper, Desktop Dungeons & Minesweeper, among others.  How to play?   First, create your Character... name: Legends And Lore
lang: English
short: In a world of endless possibilities your tale is unwritten. Experience classic ttrpg's like never before as you roll dice, build worlds, and roleplay in the bodies of the creatures you create. Bring life to your stories with Legends And Lore. For Desktop (keyboard and mouse) and VR
about: Legends & Lore  is a VR or Desktop (with keyboard and mouse) role playing  tool . Inspired by tabletop role playing games (aka TTRPG)  like Dungeons and Dragons, Pathfinder, and many others; the core of our tool is you and your friends telling a story together. You start by choosing between playing as a Game Master (aka GM) or one of up to four Adventurers. Game Masters create the stories and worlds that Adventurers traverse. Guiding them through quests for treasure, battles with deadly foes, daring rescues, and much more. As an Adventurer you roleplay as your character through those scenarios, adding your characters personality and ambitions to the story. The gameplay is what's known as a player driven story. Meaning every playthrough will be different. What you say, what you do, and how you work with your team influence the outcome and flow of the story. Legends And Lore is a dynamic system that gives unique tools to both Game Masters and Adventurers, in order to bring your ttrpgs to life!         Adventurer Players who choose the Adventurer role design their characters. The design goes deeper than most RPGs, instead of just looks and skills you delve deeper into character creation through designing your characters alignment, backstory, and personal beliefs. You then roleplay that character and have all of that influence how they interact with the world and others. In a ttrpg your roleplay is everything and helps to create the story of your adventure.          Game Master Players who choose the Game Master role design the world and npcs that adventurers experience. Game Masters act as the god of the world and are responsible for narrative flow, creating the scenario/environment, and providing dynamic feedback. Leaving them in charge of everything that happens (outside of the adventurers direct actions) and the overall narrative of the story. The GM’s job is to create an adventure that's exciting, fun, and challenging. Both Adventurers and Game Masters meld together to create a story that has the possibility to unfold in any way possible, meaning no two playthroughs are alike.           To report any bugs or to join our community and find other roleplaying enthusiasts visit our Discord server

name: OverlayGG: Game Guide Overlay
lang: English
short: Stuck on a boss, quest or build? Search 100,000+ step-by-step guides for 120+ games in a small see-through overlay that sits right on top of your game. No alt-tabbing, no full-screen browser, no ads.
about: Stuck? The answer's already on your screen.   We've all been there. You hit a boss you can't crack, or a quest that won't tell you where to go next, so you alt-tab to look it up on Google or a wiki, dig through three ad-covered pages, and by the time you tab back the game's minimized and you've half-forgotten what you read.  OverlayGG fixes that. It's a small, transparent overlay that sits on top of your game and gives you instant access to 100,000+ step-by-step guides across more than 120 games. Press F4, search for what you need, glance at the answer without leaving the game, and hide the overlay when you're done.           Why not just alt-tab?      Alt-tabbing  pulls you out of the game and onto ad-covered wiki pages.     Full-screen guide viewers  cover your whole game while you read.     OverlayGG  is a small window you place where you want. Lock it, and you can keep playing with the guide on screen.     What's inside      100,000+ guides for 120+ games:  boss fights, raid encounters, character builds, crafting recipes, achievement chains, hidden quests, faction questlines, build orders, settings tweaks, and more.     Instant search.  Find guides by game, mechanic, or question. Search handles common typos, abbreviations, and partial names.     Lockable click-through.  While the overlay is locked, clicks over non-interactive areas pass through to the game. Unlock it when you want to search, scroll, or edit notes.     Configurable hotkeys.  Lock or unlock the overlay with the default \ key, and show or hide it with F4. Both shortcuts are configurable.     Make it yours.  Adjust opacity, text size, and screen position, and choose from 8 themes: Dungeon, Starship, Wildwood, Relic Vault, Arcanum, Cyberpunk, Retrowave, and Royal.     Personal notes and favorites.  Save reminders alongside guides and keep frequently used guides easy to find.     Flag any guide  for correction right from the app.     Safe Mode backup.  Open OverlayGG as an ordinary resizable desktop window when the transparent overlay window is not usable on your setup.     Guides for more than 120 PC games   Coverage spans RPGs, MMOs, action-adventure games, survival and crafting games, strategy games, competitive multiplayer games, and achievement-focused games. Coverage varies by game and continues to expand.  A few highlights:  Elden Ring, Escape from Tarkov, League of Legends, Valorant, Dota 2, Grow a Garden, Genshin Impact, PUBG: Battlegrounds, Blox Fruits, Honkai: Star Rail, World of Warcraft, Path of Exile 2, Final Fantasy XIV, Hearthstone, Old School RuneScape, Rust, Diablo IV, Wuthering Waves, Zenless Zone Zero, Grand Theft Auto Online, Dead by Daylight, Slay the Spire 2, Marvel Rivals , and many more. See the full list at .  The guide catalog includes popular non-Steam games too. OverlayGG can display over many games regardless of launcher, but visibility depends on the game's display mode and your system configuration.   How it works   Launch OverlayGG through Steam, search for a topic, and choose a guide. The written steps appear in the OverlayGG window.  In Overlay Mode, OverlayGG uses a transparent always-on-top window for compatible borderless/windowed setups. It can run from the system tray, and closing the app exits it. If a guide contains an external video or page, that link opens in your default browser.   Compatibility and Safe Mode   OverlayGG is designed for borderless/windowed play.  Tip: set your game to Borderless Windowed for best results.  Some fullscreen configurations may require changing the game's display mode or keeping OverlayGG on a second monitor. Compatibility can also vary with game updates, graphics settings, system configuration, and current publisher or anti-cheat rules.  Safe Mode is an ordinary desktop-window backup for setups where the transparent overlay window itself will not run. It cannot draw over a game and is not an anti-cheat or fullscreen bypass.   One-time purchase     No subscriptions    No DLC    No ads,

short: Race against rival billionaires, conquer a multi-phase open-world sandbox, and solve a giant roguelite sky puzzle to escape a dying planet. Command an electric airship empire solo or in couch co-op. Manage time, survive escalating pirate hordes, and discover the path to the center of the Earth!
about: Blimps  is a top-down, multi-vehicular sandbox RPG and roguelite "escape room" built for solo captains and local couch co-op duos.  The surface world is running out of resources. Your ultimate objective is simple but monumental: find a way to escape it. To survive, you must master a steep learning curve, piece together a giant mechanical puzzle, and optimize your strategy across multiple play sessions. Every time you leave your Hangar, you lose power, pollution clouds spread, and rival pirate blimps multiply across the sky. Time is ticking. Can you solve the world of Blimps before you are completely overwhelmed?  The Three Game Phases of The Sky  Your journey to escape is broken into a dynamic, shifting campaign where every second matters (10 real-world seconds equals 15 minutes of game time):  *  The Opening Game: The Billionaire Space Race (Days 1–3):  Race against ruthless corporate competitors—Space Y, Nile X, and Sir Space—to reach the Moon. Recruit 10 VIP crew members and secure 10 Golden Cargo crates to launch a rocket to the Moon (and maybe even a hidden silo to Mars) to locate the mythical Moon Crystal. Secure first place within 3 game days to claim a $1,000,000 reward!  *  The Middle Game: The Sandbox Expansion:  With the timed space race settled, the world expands into a building and survival playground. Establish solar and fusion towns, fight to become the King of the Seven Kingdoms, and take on arcade mini-games to boost your ultimate score.  *  The End Game: The Earth Drill Escape:  Use the Moon Crystal to power your Earth Drill beneath your Hangar. Educate and train your crew, power up and board your drill, and plunge to the center of the Earth paradise before the surface collapses.  Dynamic Elemental (Water>Fire>Ice) Warfare and Arcade Mini-Games  Break away from the hangar and cockpit to complete tasks that grant game-changing score bonuses, gold, and ship upgrades:  *  Tactical Dogfights:  Engage rivals in fast-paced twin-stick shooting or close-quarters, elemental "Rock-Paper-Scissors" combat (Water douses Fire, Fire melts Ice, Ice freezes Water).  *  4-Floor Dungeon Crawl:  Descend in a mini earth drill into  Goldgotts Dungeon . Extinguish flames with your water gun to harvest fire ammo, and smash rocks with your shovel plow to extract raw gold. Battle Shiska Bob, a giant flame boss, on the bottom floor! Smelt the raw gold into bars after each run and use them to upgrade your Blimp's size and specs.  *  Side-Scrolling Side View Gauntlet:  Fly and shoot through a 2D platformer highway. Pop open hot-air-balloon crates to steal gold bars, shoot down cyberplane minions, and battle  The Dogcatcher —a pirate blimp captained by an annoying, barking dog.  *  2D Top-Down Cyberpunk Motorcycle Race:  Switch gears entirely and drop onto a neon-drenched track. Race solo or with a partner through a dark cyberpunk setting to gather 8 glowing crystals. Deposit them into 8 active turret towers to win 8 precious gemstones, then secure them at the  Gemstone Greenhouse  to claim your race winnings!  *  Multi-Vehicular Mastery:  Take control of deep-sea submarines, earth-drilling machines, hot-air balloons, motorcycles, slingshots, and even a funicular!   A Replayable, Hardcore Roguelite Puzzle  Blimps does not hold your hand. It is a deep, intricate system designed for multiple runs. While a perfect first-time escape is possible for the most meticulous captains, true mastery comes from learning what to do, when to do it, and how to optimize your route.  * Use your in-game  Captain's Log  to track complex missions and the  H.E.L.P.
